dkar chagagleng brjod/ 7cos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/ 11kha skong dang po/ spong rong mi rje chen po lha sras tshe dbang rnam rgyal la phul ba lugs gnyis phun chodags dpal ste ra/ 40kha sgo nga gnyis pa/ skyong rong du chos bzhin sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug mi rje tshe dbang rnam rgyal la btsun mo/ khab bzhes skabs legs 'bul gyi skyes dang bcas phul ba sde bzhi'i legs tshogs lha 'phar 'byed pa'i lde mig 45kha skong gsum pa/ spong rong du dzadas bzhin du sa skyong ba mi rje chen po yab rje tshe dbang bstan 'dzin de nyid la phul ba snyan tshig gi 'phreng ba'i sarga dang po/ 51kha skong bzhi pa/ spo ro/nga mi rje chen po rje dbon tshe dbang rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i zhal gdams snyan ba3/la tshangs pa'i rnga chen/ 55kha skong lnga pa/ spong rong rgan chen tshe dbang dpal rgyas la gdams pa/ 65 ṅga dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re gar bzhugs 'dir hre gas gcig tu bsdebs pa/ 714 3

'brog sde chen po po rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /mnga' ri ba chos rgyal chen pos mdzad pa'i dga' ba'i ga'as zhes bya ba rtsed sna bcu gsum pa'i rim pa gsal ba'i me long 105rgyal gzhas kyi gleng bsnyungad/ 117dre rong gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/ 121rgyal gzhas 'khrab tshan 11 skurware gzhas tshig bkod par/ 127phebs bsku'i gzhas glu/ 127ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ 128sgo bshad kyi le'u/ sgo mo phye/ 129gzhas kyi sgo mo phye glu/ lde mig g.yar po gnang dang / 129spyan 'dren gyi gzhas/ gangs stod ya ru rdzong gcig chags/ 130ja macesad/ 131sa yi mchodad pa/ sa btul gyi le'u/ 132moja' dar/ 133dang rgyan pa/ 135dpal gyi chos 'kho ra lha sa/ 136rong gsum rong / 137bla ma'i bstod glu/ e ma le ho/ — 138ri bo brgya/ 139a ce rgya bza' bsu gzhas/ zla ba dang po'i tshes pa bco lnga/ 140snod bcud kyi bstod glu/ gangs stodad ya ru su bzhugs/ 1424

sa gzhi pa dma/ 143 nam dus kyi glu/ zla la dbyar zla/ 144gangs stod mthon po/ 144rtsed sna/ ja khang nga / 145snam las kyi gzhas/ ras ma 'dren pa'i gzhas/ 147gzhas pa tsharware 'khrab chas kyi gzhas/ khyug khyug la/ 148ras pa 149gus btud kyi gzhas/ phyag gsum pa/ 151rtsed sna kho chag pa/ 153rtsed sna rma bya/ 155rtsed sna gsung gdangs nga / 156 dpa' brtul gyi gri rtsed/ gri bshad/ (1) 156gri bshad/ (2) 158gri bshad/ (3) 160gri bshad/ (4) 162gri bshad/ (5) 163phywa g.yang gi gzhas/ phywa 'gugs/ g.yang 'gugs/ 163rgyal gzhas kyi 'khrab chas/ 164la stodad yul gzhas kyi gleng brjod/ 167phra da la stod khul gyi yul gzhas 'khrab tshul dang gzhas sna 5

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /khag cig gi gzhas byodrog 173gangs can ngo da kyi bstan pa/ 173 bal yul gnas mjal gyi kuthul gzhas/ phyag 'tshal sgang nas bltas pas/ 173gangs dkar ti se gnas gzhas/ la de sgro la ma la/ 174stod gzhas brag stod gser la byas yod/ 175brag dkar rta sorware bstod pa/ 176bod kyi khor yug gi bstod pa/ ri de g.yang chags ri/ 177yul lha'i bstod pa/ sgang dmar che mo'i bzhugs khang / 178zhing pa'i yul gzhas/ yar lung lcang gsar/ 178yul gyi bltod pa/ phu yi bsam gling dgon pa/ 179lha da kyi gangs chen gangs chung / 179'bras gachoṭang la/ 180bkra shis gsol ba'i gzhas tshig 181ga bkra la shis pa'i rtsa ba/ jo na mo'i chu la bcol yod/ 181kha sdu gas la shar gyi phyogs nas bkra re shis/ 182ga nam dus kyi bkra shis gso/la ba/ 184nga bkra shis pa'i gyes gzhas/ 185ca bkra shes rgyab skyor/ 187'brel yod 'dra dpar khag 1896

gleng brjod/gle nga brjod/gna' dus kyi rgyal phran 'brog sde ba spo rong gi lo rgyus gang thob cig 'di nas phyogs sgrig byas khul yang khungs gtugs yig cha daskodzin dbang 'gor gzhi che tsam byung / stabs legs shig la byes phebs spo gro nga pa bgres so/nga byas can mang dag cig nas ngag rgyun gyi 'o/ rgyus gang mang lhod zhu thub pa byung ba rnams kyang 'di nas rang gar ma bzhag par gang thub yig rnying 'o/ rgyus dang khungs gtugs ra sprod dang / khungs gtugs ma thub pa rnams ni rang gar bzhag pa bcas yin/ 'di nas snga phyi'i 'o/ rgyus rnams byung rabs la gzhigs te deb phreng gnyis su spar bskrun bgyis par/ deb phreng gnyis pa'i nang spo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rabs dang / spo rong gi gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/ la sta da khul gyi gzhas sna grags chen kha shas bcas kyi skar sa bcad gsum bkod sku da/sa bcad dang po 'bur ba'i gdung rabs ni/ rab byung bcu bzhi lcags 'byug (1820) lor skyid gro nga brag dkar rta so'i brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug (1775 /837) gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum bris ma pod bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs khongs nas spa rong rje dbon gyi 'e rgyus ((chos ldan sa skyong 'bur ba mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 7

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/nyi /zhes pa dang / de min spo rong rje dbon la phul ba'i chab shog gsum bcas da bar dpar skrun byung myong med par mngon/ brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug nyid kyi gsung 'bum pod bcu grangs zhis phyi lo 1992 lor bal yul nub ri sa ma sgang du slob dpon 'gyur med zhu bas bdag nyar mdzad pa dus da lta'ang bris mar bzhugs mus nas/ 'bur ba'i gdung rabs 'di da lan 'di nas thog mar dpar skrun zhu gi yod/ 'di ni spo rong rje dbon gyi gdung rabs bris ma gcig kho na de min nam snyam/ gsham gsal 'bur ba'i gdung rabs dang chab cadag khag nas gsal rtewags thub nges ltar maḥthodag rig 'dzin chen po'i sku dus tsam nas spo rong rje dbon dang brag dkar rta so'i bla rabs dbar mchod yon gyi 'brel ba zab po byung bar mngon/ 'bur ba'i gdung rabs 'di'ang rje dbon tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyis bskul ba ltar brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad par gsal/ de rjes rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug nyid kyi slob ma brag dkar ba /rma lakṣim zhu bas rje dbon tshe dbang rnam rgyal zhing gshegs kyi rjes ྅kyi'i 'khrungs rtags su rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i snang brnyan brgya phrag gsum brgal ba dang zhal thang bcas bzhengs 'dug pas/ zhal thang 'di bzhin deng bod kyi dpal mo chodas sdings kyi nang rten khongs bzhugs pa kho bos mjal/ zhal thang de'i rgyab ngo sa su /rma lakṣim pas mdzad pa'i bsngo spyodan 'di 'dra zhig mjal rgyu 'dug

gleng brjod/ra༅7/ /skyon su sdi/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus mi 'khrugs rgyal ngo yi/ /snang brnyan dad pas skrun pa'i dge ba yis/ /sa skyong mi dbang dam pa de nyid kyi//thugs brgyud la gnas/ sdig sgrib nyes rnying kun/ /byang zhing dag nas mngon dga'i zhing mchog der/ /myur du rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces pa'ang spo rong sa skyong mi rje tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i dgongs rdzogs su mi 'khrugs pa'i snang brnyan brgya phrag gsum lhag zhal gser mdza na ris kyi bkra ba legs par bzhengs pa'i ri mo'i 'du byed kyang mchodag gsum kun 'dus rje cad dam pa brag dkar ba chodas kyi dbang phyug de pa'i bka' drin gyi rtag tu 'dzapa ba'i bka' 'bangs kyi mtha' shal garma lakṣim zhes pas mang yul mgon nang gi ri khrodad du bris pa ring min rnam mkhyen lnga gas sangs kyi go 'phang thodab pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o/ dge'o/ maṅga waṃ// zhes 'khod/lo ngo sum brgya tsam gyi sngon du brag dkar ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i 'bur ba'i gdung rabs 'di bzhin dus de ring gi bar brag dkar ba rim drodan gyis gces nyar mdzad pa ni brag dkar ba bka' drin che/ 'on te rje dacadan tshe dbang rnam rgyal rjes kyi rje daphra na mi rabs bzhi tsam nas 'di lta bu'i legs par bshad cing sug bris su bzhugs mus rang nyid kyi gdung rabs dag dpar skrun mdzad rgyu lta ci lo rgyus de 'dra zhig sku da med kyang mkhyen lta gas byung e sku da snyam pa'i snang ba 'char/ gang ltar rtsa brlag tu ma song bar mjal rgyu sku da pa ni dga' spro'i rang bzhin yin/ rgya gar skad 9

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /du/ de ra se a ya/ dhū rusaḍa a ya/ zhes pa ltar/ phyis tsam byon na'ang legs par byon pa yin pas dge'o/ /da gecad/ /phyi sku 2008 zla 11tshes 30 nyin bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha cadar gyi 'dabs su phan phyi zla ba dar rgyas kyis bris/

༄༅༅/ /chos ldan sa skyong 'bar pa mi rje'i gdung rabs ༷drod bsgyu 05 ril rgyus mad ḍūrya' ༷phrang ba zhas bya ba bzhugs sa//ra༅༅//rgyal badza kun gyi gsang gsum dbyings///ma par snang mad sgyu 'phruX gar/ /phyagasalasarnazlopa/rgyalagebaXlha//thams cad man sa da lags 34la//ོ༵bas bcu'i /palamanga' tshogaX gnyis 'o/ /rgya 'bar ba/ gzis//da ba/bas darabacardo mun bcam phan ba 'dab brgya tshal//rgyas masaX thub dbang sa gardong chos dang /༷ 'phags tshogs//thugs rja' snang ba dam pas 'ar bsrung da lags mdzod// chos dbyingasayesheshesolhaXrdzingaringanas///brgyasa'achad rtsad ༵༵ pa 'dashāka~X can// lagaX bshad rdodud me ga bur ba/rna na mkhan //smra ba' zla ba 'gas da grags pas ngas//

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / thub bstan dri med chu klung kun 'du zhing //lung rtogs yon tan nor bu'i gter gyur pa//bshad sgrub gzha na phan 'phrin las rlabs 'phreng can//mkhas grub rin chen 'byung gnas rnams la 'dud//gang gi ring lugs chos srid rgyal thabs la//dbang bsgyu ra mi bdag rigs kyi 'phreng ba ni//yon tan rin chen du ma'i phra tshom can//chos ldan sa skyong rim par byon rnams bsngags//ya rabs dam pa'i ngang tshul ma med pas // gzhan las khyad zhugs rigs rus ngo mtshar gyi//dpal yon 'dzin 'di'i sngon byung da lta'i bar//lo rgyus ya mtshan gtam gyis dga' ston bya//de yang bsil ldan ra ba dkar pos khor yug gis bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir 'phags mchodag phyag na padmo'i thugs rje'i phrin las kyi so/da snang 'bo ga pa med par shar bas phan bde'i pad tshal kun nas rgyas shing / rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen 4 gyi bstan pa rin po che rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par du byas pa lung dang rtogs 12

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/pa'i bdag nyid can dar zhing rgyas la/ bye brag tu gdul bya so so'i mos ngor 'artar zhing kun kyang rnam par grol ba'i lam bzang kho nar dkri ba'i ring lugs thri snyed pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes bu 'phags chen sprul pa'i rnam rol btsun mkhas bzang sngo dang grub pa'i brtul zhugs stodag tu ma gyur par mnga' ba lha lam gyi khyestun yangs por rgyu skar gyi grangs dang mtshungs pa zhig byon pa dang / bstan pa rin po che dang de 'dzin gyi skyes chen dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa gus par mchodad cing 'dzin skyong spel ba'i chos srid gnyis ldan gyi mngon par mtho ba /ce ra 'dzin gyi khyon la chos bzhin du skyong ba'i rgyal sngo 'ang bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig byon par gyur pa de dag gi lo rgyus sngon byung gi rabs ni gzhan du gsal ba las blo gros kyi nor dang ldan pa dag gis shes par bya la/'dir skabs su bab pa'i gleng bar bya ba ni sa skyong ba'i dbang phyug mi'i lha 'bur pa zhes pa 'di nyid gang las byung ba'i gdung rabs kyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i ngang tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ de la bod yul 'dir che bar grags pa mi'u gdung drug las/ ji skad du/dga' ldong 'bru gsum dbra dang bzhi//nu bo dbal mda' gnyis te drug/ces dang gzhan yang nang tshan dbye ba'i bshad tshul mang zhing / spyir ldong dang me nyag /dmar dang / zhang zhung / (rma dang zhang zhung / ) se dang ha shang ('a zha ) sogs rus chen bzhi dang / brgyad dang / bco brgyad la sdudags pa

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / yod par grags pa las/ 'dir ni ldong yin cing / de la yang gser ldong ser po/ mchong ldong smug po / dung ldong dkar po sogs du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas gser ldong se/ra po yin no//de nas 10na gyi tshe shar chu gas ma hā tsi na ste rgya nag gi yul du rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal zur phud lnga pas byin gyis brlabs pa/ skyes bu mi'i khyu mace)ga mngal skyes kyi dri ma spangs pa ji ltar rgyal ba shākya seṅge lum bi ni'i tshal du sgyu 'phrul yum gyi rtsib logs nas gnod pa med par sku bltams pa bzhin skyed byed ma'i rtsib logs nas 'bur te 'khrungs pa zhig byung bas gdung gi mtshan du'ang 'bur pa zhes 'jig rten du mngon par grags so/ /de nyid rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi lang tsho mchodag tu gsal bas rtsis kyi rig pa la shin tu mkhas par gyur te ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen po der rtsis rig gi sgo nas skye 'gro mang por blang dor gsal ba'i mig sbyin zhing legs pa'i sku na tan brgya phrag gi lha phar 'byed pa'i gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad pa las rim par rigs rgyud kyi 'phreng ba zam mi chad par mi thog mang zhig song ba las/ mthar gdung rgyud gcig bod chen po'i yul mdze khams smad du byon/'brog sde chen po zhig gi dpon du gyur te mi rabs mang du song ba na/ gdung rgyud gcig bod yul dbus su yar byon/ dbus skyid shod kyi yul phran gnam pa zhes pa'i dpon mi thog gsum mdzad/ der gnam phu'i yul gyi bon po mthu che ba zhig dang 'khon te yar klungasasu byom rdzong brgya lhag tsam gyi dpon po 14

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/byas/ de'i sras gcig 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bgam yas mi 'gyur lhan gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs shing / mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'jojams pa'i skabs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i ya gyal gcig yin par grags/ de nas mi rabs mang zhig sku nga nas dpon gcig gis lho bdag po si tu chos kyi rin chen dbus nas la stod lhor byon pa'i phyag g.yog zhus te sa skya brgyud la stod lhor phebs/ phyag gasku ga dbus pa mi dgu/ gso/la gzim gnyis dang bcu gcig sku da pa las/ gsol dngo na sri thub tu grags shing phyag gasku ga gzhan rnams la dadze na rgya re bachodas/ gsol dpon sri thub la spong 'brog pa rgyal nor srog la bab dus 'brog sde 'di dang /bza' po tham brgya gang 'dam gsungs pas 'brog sde 'dam zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan phul bas sang 'brog pa yar pa/ mar pa/ stod pa/ smad pa ste 'brog sde bzhi dgos g.yog tu byung / de dag gi nang tshan spong 'brog dang / rong 'brog gnyis rgya che bas mnga' 'bangs su bskyangs pas spong rong pa zhes grags so//de dus la stod phyogs 'dir 'grog sde bco brgyad yod pa'i nang nas kun gyi gtso wa ra gyur/ gso/la dawa na sri thub la sras khro phan/ nge la sras gsum byung ba'i sras gcig gi lho bdag mo btsan lcam gyi gsol dpon byas/ byang du byon pa de'i rgyud zang zang dkar po zhes pa'i brgyud pa byung bar grags/ sras bar pa la kho rgyal 'bum/ de'i gcung gnas seng pa byams pa chos seng du grags pa bar 'brog rdo rje gling dang / gnas seng sogs su sgrub pa la yun ring gzhol 15

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / bas grub pa brnyes te nam mkha' la phur ba sogs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston nus pa zhig byung / kho rgyal 'bum gyi sras kho bo shi ma dang /gcung gnyis te sku mched gsum byung / gcung po gcig gtsang nyang smad bkra shis lhan por gangs can mgon po ngur smrig 'chang ba bdun gyi dang po rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi spyan sngar sku chos mdzad dka' bcu bde legs pa zhes mtshan nyid kyi ston pa bzang ba zhig byung ste 'dis steng 'gro dang sgo bo'i bla ma yang mdzad/ gcung po gcig mnga' ris glo bo'i phyogs su byon/ grub thob gcig byung skad do//khro bo shi mar sras gsum byung ba'i che ba thod dong nam mkha' rin chen/ bar pa brgya dpon bsod mgon/ chung ba pha rgod bde chen mgon sngogeng/ /bo snga nga nam mkha' rin chen gyis mdo phyogs mtshan nyid bo dong bya rgod gshongs su thugs sbyong dang / sngags kyi rim pa rnams nyid kyi zhang po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa sems dpa' nam mkha' rdo rje'i dru nga du gsan/ kun mkhyen 'jigs bral chen wa'i dngos chodab thabs lam kyi bka' bab grub pa brnyes pa shangs pa bsod nams mchog gyur la'ang gtugs shing gdams pa zab mo'i thugs rgyud grol bar mdzad/mnga' ris rdzong dkar chos sde dkar po'i mkhan por mnga' gsol/ mkhas grub kyi yon tan phul du byung zhing dgung lo lnga bcu bzhes pa'i mthar bo do9ོngatsho e'i gzim khang dkar por dag zhing du gshegs/brgya dasngo na bsod mgon gyi gcung pha bde chen mgon po ni/ gachodan nu nas 16

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/thugs chos su song yang gcen gyi bkas ma gnang bar dgung lo bco brgyad bar 'asnga ga gzhis su bzhugs/ bcu dgu pa la chos bros mdzad/ steng dkar gyi bla sda bsam gtan pa sogs bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ rgyal phu shig ra/ rdor gling / g.yang ga lung / rdza stag sgo sogs su lo bcu gnyis su dka' thub bcud len la bsten pa'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ spyan ras gzigs dmar po dang dkar po'i zhal mngon sum du bstan te 'bral ba med par grib ma bzhin 'aX gas/ snyam mchog gi dgon ro gcig mo da par bzhugs te sgrub pa rgyang tsam mdzad/ lan gcig phyir phebs tshe a tsa ra mdog cung zad sngo ba skra thod du bcings pa rna bar dung long btags pa gcig dang dngos su mjal/ khos yar byon gyi brda' byung /de'i rjes la byon nas da lta'i pha boong la a tsa ra de thim song / de ni dpal mgon po myur mdzad phyag drug pa'am/ kṣe ṭa pa la dngos yin par grags/ de nas pha wong de gzim phug gi nang du yong ba byas nas gzim spyil btab/ deng sang sgam mchog gi thil dkar ram bil por brjod pa 'brog skad ma dag pa'i ngag rgyun 'byams pa las gzhan du spyil sngo 'am gzim spyil yin na//bla brang 'du khang / grwa shag spyil po mo gas btab cing dgon gnas sgrub grwa rim pas je rgyas su gyur/ yi dam gyi gtso bo thugs rje chen po dang / bla ma'i gce wa bsam gtan mtshan can/ chos kyi gtso bo thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid/phyag chen ni gu sogs shangs chos gser chos lnga dang / byang gter thugs sgrub /7

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa/ tshes bcu sogs dar rgyas su mdzad/ lto bdag byang bdag gnyis gas dbu blar gyur/ dgung lo don brgyad par po ta la'i zhing khams su gshegs so/ /skabs 'dir rje nam mkha' rdo rje dang shes rab rgyal mtsho'i rnam thar lo rgyus shig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang yi ger 'khod pa sogs mi snang bas cha ma 'tshal lo bo dodang nam mkha' rin chen sku mched gsum gyi bar pa brgya dpon bsod mgon la sras dpon po dpal 'bar gcig po byung / de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba dakhrodan po mtsho skyes rdo rje/ chung ba rje nam mkha' 'od zer yin la/ 'di nyid spen zhes pa'i 'brog gi tshal du 'khrungs/ rgyal sras nam mkha' dkon mchog gi drung du bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ bya rgod gshongs su lo brgyad kyi ring mtshan nyid theg pa'i sde snod la sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ byang ya ga chos sdings su jo stan (gdan ) bkra shis chos 'phel la bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan blo gros rtse mo/ grags pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gsol/ sgo mo nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ snye mo ru 'dzam gling rab 'byams pa dang / yar 'brog bsam sdings su sprul sku 'chi med dpal bzang sogs bsten te smin grol gyi chos tshul mang du gsan/shel dkar chos sde'i cha/khan po yun ring mdzad/ dpal mo chos sdings kyi gdan sa lo gcig tsam bskyangs/ gzhan yang gnas nges med du sgrub pa la gzhol/tshotshomakhas grub kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' zhing gzhan phan rlabs tstsha ba mo gas spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rdo rje'i sprul par grags/ dgung lo re 18

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/gsum pa lcags sprul gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la bsam rtser mya ngan las 'das/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ya mtshan gyi ltas bzang snga mtha' yas pa dang / sku gdung la lha sku dang ring bsrel grangs med pa byon skad do//mtshungs med nam mkha' 'od zer gyi a jo dpon po mtsho skyes rdo rje la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba la/ thams cad ma khyen pa nam mkha' rin chen/ bar pa mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chung ba dpon po nor bu dpal bzang dang gsum las/ sras che ba nam mkha' rin chen ni/ rgyal bu g.yu rnyed ces pa'i 'brog gi tshal du sku 'khrungs/ de'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing / nam mkha' nas/mgon po ngag gi dbang phyug ni//srid zhugs srid nga/'i gos pa med//ye shes ral gri 'bar ba yis//nyes tshogs kun las rnam par rgyal//zhes pa'i sgra byung / sgra de las brtsams te mtshan mgon po rnam rgyal du btags/dgung lo brgyad par rgyal sras nam mkha' dkon mchog drung du bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ mtshan nam mkha' rin chen du gsol zhing / dgung lo bcu pa nas bzung klog pa thos bsam la sbyangs pa nan gtan du mdzad/ chos sdings su rje shes rab rgya mtsho dang / mnyam med nam mkha' 'od zer las rang lugs mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rnams gsan/ chos 'khor phug dang / gyam chos sdings

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long / dang / shel dkar chos sde'i mkhan po rnams yun ring du mdzad do//de nas dge 'dun 'du ba'i gnas gzhi zhig btab par dgongs pa na gang du 'debs pa legs thugs dbo ngas gtad pa'i tshe/ nub gcig casdod gsal gyi nyams la sman grong g.yu mtsho'i 'jug ngogs na/ sa 'og lto 'phye nas nam mkha'i lha phran gyi bar 'dus te/ nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i phrin las can/ /zhes sogs kyi gsol ba 'debs pa na/ de dag la thugs snying rje chen pos gzigs te kye ma sems can 'di rnams byang sham bha lar rigs ldan rnam gnon gyi drung du skyes te 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i chos la spyod par gyur cig gsungs pa na/ de rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ kyi rgyal ba'i sras po/ bdag cag rnams mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du sme na lam 'debs pa lags so zer ba la/ rje nyid kyis bsam pa dag pas smon lam btab pa bzhin/mngon par dga' ba chos kyi pho brang du/ /skye 'gro sems can thams cad gnas gyur nas//thub dbang rin chen chos kyis 'tsho bar shog/ces gsungs/ 'od gsal las bzhengs pa'i rjes shes su/ chos 'od du dgon pa'i gnas gzhi bcas pa legs par dgongs te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs rgyud sde rin po che dang / chos 'dul ba nas ji ltar bshad pa dang mthun pa'i chos grwa chen po phyi nang rten brten par bcas shing / gling so so'i grwa khang dang bces pa legs par btab/ chos grwa'i ming yang sngar gyi gzigs snang dang mthun par 20

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i bdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/mngon dga' chos sde zhes btags so//sku gsung thugs rten dpag tu med pa bzhengs bya ba las/ klog pa thos bsam/sgrub pa bsam gtan te 'khor 'o/ gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' zhing / spyodas kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor/ dgung lo bdun cu don lnga'i bar bzhugs shing bo dong mkhan rabs nang nas mdzad pa rgya che ba zhig ste mgon sngo 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul par grags/ mdzad pa mtha' ma mngon dga' chos sde rang du mya ngan las 'das/sku gdung ril po rgyun ring por bzhugs pa phyis sa spre sde gzar gyi skabs ri khrod zhig tu spyan drangs te gzhug la phul bar 'dug go/de nyid kyi gcung blo gros rgyal mtshan mkhan slob sbrags pa'i gdan sar bskos shing / dbon dang thugs sras kyi mchog 'dul 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal sngo la mtshan nyid theg pa'i 'chad nyan par mnga' gsol/ nam mkha' rgyal po 'di dasngo na po nor bu dpal bzang gi sras yin par nges te rnam thar zhib mo/ra cha ma 'tshal/nam mkha' rgyal 16) sku mched da3/na wa zhig la sras gsum 'khrungs pa ni/nam mkha' dkar po/ kun dga' chos 'khyodar/ tshe dga' pa gsum 'khrungs/rje nam mkha' dkar po ni gzhon nu nas skyes chen dam pa'i bag chags sad pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba dang / grub mtshan zhabs rjes kyang mang du bzhag /nam mkha' rgyal po sogs mkhas grub gyi sku ngas 'dzin mang du bsten te thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur cing rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son/ myang gi brag dmar la bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas zhal 21

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gzigs/ thugs dam thang ka las me stag 'phro ba byung zhing da lta'ang nang rten khrod du bzhugs/ mngon dga' chos sde'i khri thog tu rgyun ring ba dang / shel dkar chos sde'i mkhan po yang lo shas mdzad/ dpal mo chos sdings su yang rgyun ring bar bzhugs shing dbo na yas man du 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa rgya cher bskyangs pa'i mthar da gung lo bdun bcu don lnga pa'i thog tu chos sdings gser khang lha khang du dag zhing du gshegs/ sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa ding sang yang mngon dga' chos sde'i gtsang khang gi rten gyi gtso bo byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nang du bzhugs so/ /rje 'di'i sku tshe'i smad dang 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i sku tshe'i stod dus mtshungs par mngon /kun dga' chos 'byor ni/ khyi ra mdzad cing bsad pa gso nas sa sdudags grub pa'i brtul zhugs lkog tu ma gyur pa du ma ston pa 'brug khyodan kun legs lta bu zhig byung zhes grags/ rje dbon tshe dga' pa'i sras su rje nam mkha' nor bu/ nam mkha' grags pa/ nam mkha' maskukhen po gsum 'khrungs/ gcen nam mkha' cadar bu dang / nam mkha' grags pa gnyis kyi rje nam mkha' dkar po sdudags dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan phul du byung bas thugs mdzod gtams pa zhig yin par nges kyang rnam thar zhib tu ma 'tshal lo 91nam mkha' grags pa dgung 'o/ zhe brgyad dang / nam mkha' rgyal po zhe gsurmi bzhugs par grags/ de'i gcung rje dbon nam mkha' mgon po'i sras su rje 22

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/nam mkha' bstan 'acordon dang / rin chen mgon po/ nam mkha' dpal bzang gsum 'khrungs/ nam mkha' bstan 'dzin pho brang chen po ri ngo gru 'dzin du 7rgyal darnga/nga thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang nam mkha' bstan 'dzin du gsol/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs su mtshan nyid the ga pa'i sde sdod la mkhas par sbyangs/'di dus rje dasngo na tshe (dga' ) dang / nam mkha' mgon sngo khu tshan thugs 'dod ma snyoms pa sogs zer bun phran bu byung zhing / spong rong gi srid sde tshang ma re zhig gzhung sa chen por phul ba'i lo kha shas gzhung sa mchog nas bskyangs/ slar nam mkha' bstan 'dzin 'bras spungs nas rang gnas mngon dga' chos sder phebs/ gcung nam mkha' dpal bzang dgung lo nar mo na nas/mnga' 'bangs chos srid thams cad gzhung sa nas phyir stsal ba'i sngar srol yab mes kyi rgyun ji bzhin skyodang ba'i 'ja' sa she bam bka' drin bskyangs/ 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mya ngan las 'das rjes drug pa chen wa 7rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dang / sde srid mi'i dbang lnga sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs kyang bdag rkyen sngar spos bzhin mdzad/ rje nam mkha' bstan 'dzin ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi mngon par mtho bas macadan dga' chos sde'i mkhan por bzhugs shing / sgrub gnas chen po dpal mo chos sdings/ mnga' ris rta sga dgon sogs rang zhabs 'dzin dbang gi dgon stod smad phal cher du byon/ rang bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs te mthar dgung lo so 23

'brog sde chen po po rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /bdun bar mnga' ris nya ma mngon dga' dgon par bde chen rab rgyas zhes par bzhugs skabs kha rud chen po zhig gis gtsug lag khang 'jig pa'i rkyen gyis gnas der zhing brjes par 'dug go/gcung nam mkha' dpal bzang ni dpa' mdzangs rtul phod cing klo gros kyi dkyel yangs pa 'jig rten gyi dgra thabs la yang mkhas pas spong rong pa'i 'dzin dbang sa khongs stod smad bar gsum du rgya che ba yang 'di nyid kyi sku ring la byung bar grags/ 'di yan rje dbon dpon skya'i rigs rnams phal cher sngon srol 'brog pa'i cha lugs ral pa can bcos med de ka yod par snang / bar skabs zhig dus log 'pho 'gyur mang po dang / rje dbon nyag phra bas chos sdings sogs dgon gnas chos srid rnams yar 'brog bsam sdings pa zhabs drung sna rje phag mos 'o/ kha shas bskyangs/ nam mkha' dpal bzang gi skabs phan tshun rtso da gleng kha mchu'i sel chen po byung ba'i mthar rang srid rnams bsam sdings pa las tshur blangs te sngar srol bzhin lugs gnyis ka nas dar rgyas su bskyangs/ me lug dbus gtsang dus zir gyi skabs mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal stod phyogs su dmag bskul bar byon dus rta dmag brgya phrag lhag pa sogs snga phyir zhabs 'degs yang dag par sgrub pa'i bdag rkyen du gtan tshigs she bam rig tshican stsal zhing thugs gtsigs shin tu che/ ris med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen skyes chen dam pa mang por gus pas sri zhu dang / zab chos dbang lung khrid 24

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/gsum mang du gsan te nang gi rnal 'byor la gzhol bas khyim spyod gsang sngags 'chang bar bsngags/ de dag gi nang nas rje rig 'dzin chen po gaḥthog pa rdo rje (gdan pa ) tshe dbang nor bu rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten te rdzogs chen phung po zag med dang / rje sgam wa pa'i thugs bcud gsang lam bla ma sgrub pa'i nyams khrid gsan te thugs rgyul grol/ skabs shig chos sdings su zhabs gras blon po zhig gi spyod pa ma bzo bar thugs snyung bas 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam du btang ba'i sdig sbyong du chos sdings gtsug lag khang gi 'dab 'byar du ma ṇi skor chen lha khang dang bcas pa dang / mngon dga' chos sder ma ṇi lha khang gong mtshungs/gcen rin chen mgon gyi dgongs rdzogs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gser chos rin khrod che'i phra tshom can 'gran zla med pa zhig dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ slob dpon chen po sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad dang bcas pa'i zhal thang grwa tshar/ grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i zhal thang grwa tshar rgyu dang bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad bzang rgya cher bskrun/ sku gshegs rjes gsag sbyang gi gdung rten du gser zangs kyi byang chen mchod rten rin po che'i phra tsho ma can chos sdings lha khang ma mor bzhugs/ 'khrungs rtags rje rig 'dzin chen por zhus pa 'phags yul gyi grub thob chen po go bo rakṣa pa'i snang brnyan thang ka bzhengs pa'i rgyab byang spyodan tshig rgyas pa'i rjes su/'di bzhengs dge bas dad ldan slob ma ni//

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /nam mkha' dpal bzang gang de bdag ci 'dra'i//'bras bu ring min chabs cig nyid du ni//grub par mdzod cig ma hā gu ru rje//zhes bka' rtsom du stsal lo//nam mkha' dpal bzang gi sras su/ nam mkha' 'gyur med dang / rdo rje lha skyabs gnyis 'khrungs/ gcen gyis rab tu byung zhing gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po bdun pa 7rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar gtsug phud phul/mtshan blo bzang 'jigs med dbang ngo ra gso/la/ rang lugs mdo sngags kyi gdan sa stod smad kun rje dbon mkhan rabs gong ma'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs/ris med pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mang du bsten te rang gzhan gyi chos tshul rgya mtsho'i thugs kyi bum bzang bkang / khyad par rig 'dzin gcithog pa tshe dbang nor bu las gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas thugs rgyud smin cing grol/ jo nang rje btsun dam pa tā ra na tha'i bka' 'bum gsung par du 'khod pa dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du gang bzhugs glegs bam yongs su sngo gas pa dang / bka' 'khor lo mtha' ma nges don snying po'i glegs bam drug tshar mang po/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum sogs bzhengs par mdzad pa chos sdings bka' 'gyur lha khang du bzhugs/ mthang dgung lo bzhi bcu par dag zhing du gshegs pa'i gdud rdzo rten gser gdung thog tshad ma bzhengs pa'i nang du sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa sa spre sde gzar skabs sdig to can mu stegs byed gorṣa'i dmag dpung gis 26

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/mngon dga' chos sde yang brlag par byas skabs gdung rten dang bka' 'gyur rin po che sogs bcoms/ sku gdung dge 'dun kha shas kyi ri khrod zhig tu spyan drang ris nas zhugs su sbyangs skad/gcung rdo rje lha skyabs ni/ thugs rgyud shin tu dul zhing byang chub sems dpa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa zhig ste / phyi ltar sngan rabs bzang po'i srol rjes su skyong ba'i mi bdag rje po'i tshul 'dzin pa tsam las nang du rje rig 'dzin chen ngo rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten te/ rta mgrin/ phur pa/ byang gter thugs sgrub/ gur drag /phyag dodar sogs yi dam mang po'i bskyed bzlas dang / phyag rdzogs kyi gnas lugs la gatshudal ba'i khyim spyodad gsang sngags 'chang bar gyur/ chos sdings lha khang dmar po'i steng du rje rig 'dzin chen po'i gdung rten gser gdung thog tshad ma lha khang mchod rdzas dang bcas/gzim khang dkar por ྅shā gdung ༷byer tsha bzhugs par rnam rgyal mchod rten dang / bka' 'bum po ti lnga/ gzhan yang rten gsum mang du bzhengs/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu chag med dang / rje 'byug pa rin po che bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta dang / dpa' nge gtsug lag dga' ba sogs skyes chen dam pa mang dze la gus pas sri zhu dang zab dzadas mnos pa sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad stabs bzang lnga phul du byung zhing / mnga' 'bangs byams brtse'i chos bzhin du bskyangs pa'i mthar dgung lo lnga bcu nga brgyad tsam la chos sdings gzim chung rtser zhing brjes pa'i gdung rten gser sbyangs las grub pa'i byang 27

'brog sdechen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chen mchodad rten rin po che du ma'i phra rgyan gyis phyug cing bum nang sgo khyim du gu ru'i sku tshab khyad 'phags can yang der bzhugs so//rdo rje lha skyabs kyi sras su rje dbon nam mkha' tshe dbang bstan 'dzin rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu phag lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i skabs gung thang ra la za 'og phug ces rje mi la ras chen dang ras chung pa'i grub gnas der rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i spyan sngar gtsug phud phul/ mtshan gong bzhin gsol/ yab kyi bka' bzhin khu sngo chos kyi rje nam mkha' 'gyur med las rab tu byung / rig 'dzin rje dang / rje 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa phrin las shing rta/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba/ sbyodar ra thams cad mkhyen pa/ yar 'grog dga' ldan sprul pa'i sku sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo bcu gcig par skyid grong mgon ri khrod du kun gzigs ma hwa paṇḍi ta lo ri ba chodas kyi rgya mtsho'i drung du sgra snyan dngags/ rtsis dkar nag sogs la gsan bsam dang / gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku gas gsang sngags gsar rnying gi smin grol mang du gsan/ dbus gtsang / kong yul/ tsā ri/la phyi chu dbar/ gangs ri ti se/ bal yul sogs kyi gnas gzigs mtha' dag mjal bskor mdzad/ bo dong rang lugs mdo sngags kyi chos grwa yas man gnyis sogs sngo na rabs kyi srol bzhin bskyangs/ skabs der yab rdo rje lha 1skyabs sku gshegs rjes sras gzhan med pas rang srid lha sde mi sde tshang mas narno gyis gsol ba bzhin ma ldog par ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan mkhan wa dang dkon 28

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/mchog gi rten gyi drung du phul nas sde bdag gi mdzad pa skyong dgos shar/ sngar spyodas pa'i khu bo cos rje nam mkha' 'gyur med dang / yab rdo rje lha skyabs kyi gdang rten/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin lnga che/ rgyal gyi shri lha gdong gi gser phibs sogs nyams gasku / thub pa'i dbang nyurware mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing / 7rgyal ba phyag na padmo'i 'khrungs rabs sogs thang ka mang ba bzhengs/kun rig gi chod ga stong tshar gyi mtshon rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rlabs che/ 7rgyal dbang /rma pa bdud 'dul rdo rjes sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' zhig gi sprul par bsngags brjod mdzad/ mthar dgung lo re gcig par zhing khams dag par gshegs so//nang rten du tsan dan las grub pa'i bcadam ldan 'das mgon po cadad dpag tu med ba gtso 'kho ra gsum dang / bka' 'gyur rin wa che so/gas bzhengs pa da lta chodas sdings gser khang lha khang du mchod rgyun dang bcas bzhugs pa 'di yin la/ gang gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshul zhib par kho bos sbyar ba'i tshangs pa lha yi rnga sgra zhes logs su yod pa las don du gnyer ba dag gis gzigs shigade nyid kyi sras su/ mi'i rje bo tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba 'di nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu mo glang lor 'khrungs/ yab mes kyi mdzad srol bzang po ji bzhin skyong bzhin par da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes te phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang grags pa'i dge mtshan mngo na par gsal ba 'di'o//de yang gangs can gyi ldongs 'dir dpal ldan bo dong pa zhes pa'i ring 29

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long lugs 'di nyid kyi rgyu mtshan cung zad bshad na/ sngon gyi dus bo dong e'i chos grwa chen po'i gdan sa skyong ba'i mkhan por spyan ras gzigs dbang dge slong gi tshul du ston pa rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal la gso/la ba btab pa'i tshe gang gi zhal nas/ bdag lta bus chos grwa chen sngo de'i mkhan po mi yong bas mkhan po chen po sku ngas su rdzogs pa dag lung bstan gyi sa skya na dpang lo chen po bzhugs pas de la gsol ba lnga ba/ khong gi dbo na rgyud 'jam dbyangs bdun dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul dang bcas pas gdan sa 'di la phan thogs po yong gsung ba'i lung bstan mdzad pa'i/ 'jam dbyangs bdun ni/ dpang 'o/ blo gros brtan pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen 'jigs med grags pa/ bsheso gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rnam rgyal dang bdun na//rigs gsum rnam sprul ni/ nam mkha' rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ bo dong nam mkha' rin chen 'jam dbyangs/ bde gshegs shes rab rgyal mtshan phyag rdor yin zhes grags so//de la dpang lo ni/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dpang lo blo gros brtan pa gnyis la shong dpang gnyis zhes yongs su grags tshoḍapa'i phyi ma yin la/ gong du smos pa ltar bo dong e'i gdan sar yun ring bzhugs shing bstan pa rin po cher bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ de'i lcam sring gi dbon 30

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/ rmo lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ de'i sku tsha'i dbon po lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/de'i zhang dbon kun mkhyen 'jigs med grags pa nyid do//'jigs bral chen po 'di nyid ni/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsang ba gsum gyi rol gar bsam gyis mi khyab pa las sngo/da yul 'dir 'phags mchog 10nga btsan sgam lngatsware chos blo na sam lha ṭa zhes gangs can 'dir thog ma'i yi ge'i srol 'byed mkhan sngo gang gi yang srid 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa lo chen bai ro tsā na ste de nyid kyi rnal sprul skye srid kyi 'phreng ba bgrang yas pa'i nang nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med grags pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhes mtshan gyi rnga sgras 'dzin ma'i khyon kun yongs su khyab pa rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta chen sngo de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang /ngag dbang lha mo rdo rje dbyangs can mas dngos su rjes su bzung bas shes bya thams cad la chags thogs bral ba'i gzigs pa mnga' zhing 'chad sgyu da rtsom gsum la 'jigs pa med pa'i chadabs pa brnyes pa na/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rgyal yum rdo rje phag mos dasngo sa su zhal bstan te dbugs dbyung zhing gnang ba stsal ba ltar dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa'i chos tshul zab la rgya che ba'i bstan bakhyodas chen po glegs bam brgya dang bcu drug gi grangs su brtsams par mdzad cing bod yul 'dir 'di nyid las bstan bcos rgya che ba mdzad pa po gzhan ma byung ba ni yongs su grags la/ de nyid kyi ring lugs stod smad bar gsum du dar rgyas su gyur pa la wa dong pa'i bo lugs pa zhes grags so//31

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /de ltar dpang lo chen po blo bo sa brtan pa nas 'jam dbyangs bdun dang /rigs gsum rnam sprul rjes 'breng dang bcas pa rim par brgyud de bo dong e'i mkhan rgyud yun ring po'i bar mdzad srol byung zhing / bstan srung bkra shis gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di nyid kyang tshogs bdag glang sna dmar po'i phrin las kyi sprul par grags shing spyodan gyi dus chengab dngo na chen ngo sangs rgyas gnyis pa padmā ka ra'i spyan sngar dam snyedas srog snying phul te bstan pa srung bar khas blangs/ phyi ma'i dus 'jam dbyangs dpang 'o/ chen po blo brtan dnge na rgyud dang bcas pa'i bo lugs bstan skyong chos srung gi gtso bor gyur/ 'di nyid kyi mchod phrin rdo rje 'chang dbang mar/ e dbyibs chos kyi 'byung gnas che/ zhes pa'ang bo dong e nyid du ngos bzung dgos te/ e dgas kong ga3/ma gyi ces ni min no//bo dong rang lugs 'dzin par rloms pa'i blun po kha cig na re/ dpang lo chen lnga sa rgya gar du phebs nas bod du khyodan pa'i phyi rjes su chos bdag 'di nyid 'brangs nas byung bas rgya 'dre yin no zhes smra ba ni rgyu ma65na cha shurtom yang ma go ba'i blun gtam ma zad rang lugs kyi bstan srung la dma' 'bebs mtshan ngan du 'gyur min gzigs shig /ding sang shel dkar chos sde zhes grags pa'i dbyangs snyan dar dir du sgrog pa 'di yang sngon dus dpang lo chen po blo gros brtan pas lung gis bstan cing / lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i bka' bzhin ṅgha bdag po si tu chos kyi rin chen gyis dbo na gnas legs par btab/ lo chen 32

chos ldan sa kyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba grags pa rgyal mtshan dang kun mkhyen 'jigs bral lho gas las rnam rgyal bas chos 'khor yun ring du bskor/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang rtsod pa'i bstan pa'i dag ther mang du mdzad/ bo dong e nas chos srung bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi zhal snyan spyan drangs te dgon pa'i bka' srung du mnga' gsol/ da lta yang shel chos kyi dkor srung gtso ngo ra mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ rim par 'jam dbyangs bdun dang / rigs gsum rnam sprul las dpang lo'i sprul bar grags pa'i sems dpa' nam mkha' rdo rje sdu/gas zhabs drung nam mkha' dkar sngarware bar du mkhan thog ci rigs pas bskyangs bar snang / chodas sde'i rten gtso thub chen 'dzam gling 'od 'bar du grags pa yang bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi nang rten du 'jam dbyangs don yod rnam rgyal gyis bzhengs/ de rjes 7rgyal dbang phyag na padmo lnga pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku thog der bo lugs nyid dge lugs su bsgyur te gling chen bcu gsum gyi gras dga' ldan legs bshad gling du mngon par grags so/ /tshul 'di yang sngon rabs 'e rgyus kyi rjes 'brel du snang bas zhar byung gi 'phro sa su smras pa lags/ding sang rje dbon zhes mtshan du bsnyad pa 'di ji skad yin zhe na/ 'jigs bral chen 16) snag gi dbon mor gyur pa zhig spyan ras gzigs sprul nam mkha' rdo rje'i skabs tsam du 'bur pa mi'i rje bo dag gi yum du gyur pa de phyin rje btsun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyi snag dbon du song bas rje dbon zhes su grags pa 'di byung ste / dper mtshon na/ bod chen 'dir bla chen rnams kyi 33

'brog sde chen lnga the rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /sku mched dam sku tshar gtogs pa rnams la rje dbon zhes brjod pa bzhin chod/ kha cig rje dbon zhes ma dag par go ste dasngo na po yin pas rje dpon zer ba sogs ni mi shes shes rlom gyis blun po'i rang mtshang stodan par zad do/ /yang 'jigs bral gyi gdung dngo na yin nam snyam pa dag kyang yod pa 'dra ste / 'jigs bral chen po'i gdung ni zha ma yin la/ 'bur pa mi rje rnams kyi rigs rus ni gong du bakhyodad zin pa ltar ro/ /gang gi chos srid rtsa ba'i 'dzin khongs su/ chos sde lngar grags pa ni/ sgrub gnas dpal mo chos sdings/ shel dkar mngon dga' chos sde / gung thang chodas sde dkar po/ mnga' ris nya ma mngon dga'/nub ris rta sga dgon rnams so//de la dpal mo chos sdings ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med grags pa nyid rang gis phyag btab ste yun ring bzhugs shing mdzad pa mtha' ma yang sgrub gnas 'dir bstan/ de skabs gling bzhi yod par grags te/ gsang sngags bde chen gling / sgrub sde bsam btan gling / bshad pa chos 'khor gling / dung sgra mthong smon gling zhes pa byung yang phyi ma gnyis stong par gyur/bde chen gling ni/ shing sang lha khang dmar mor grags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen phra dang / gzhan yang 'dab 'byar gyi bla brang lha khang dang bcas pa rnams skyonan 05/ tsho sgrub sde bsam gtan gling ni 'jigs bral chen po'i skabs nang gi ri ma gnyis zab don snying po'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i sgrub pa lnga bcu par 34

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/grags pa byung zhing rgyud sde chen ྅/ bcu gnyis kyi dkyil chog mchod gar sogs kyi phyag len ma nyams pa da lta'i bar yod pa 'di yin/mngon dga' chos sde ni/ sngar smos zin pa ltar ra bo dong rang lugs kyi ma tshan nyid grwa tshang yin pas mdo grwa dang / chos sdings pa rgyud sde'i sngags grwa yin pas mdo sngags kyi chos grwa dbo na yas man gnyis gtso sngo/ra grags so/ /gung thang chos sde dkar po ni/ sngon mnga' ris chos rgyal chen po khri bsod nams lde'i btab cing / 'o/ chen grags rgyal dang / 'jigs bral chen pos chos 'khor bskor zhing / mkhan thog kyang rim par yun ring po'i bar bskyangs bar gda'/ dus phyis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing glang lor gtsug lag khang gi sbug rten brten par bcas pa zhig ral du song ba na mi rje mdza)ga bi nyams pa gso ba'i thugs bskyed ltar bkas bskul ba bzhin kho bo cag gis kyang nyams gso'i zhabs 'degs yang dag par tshul bzhin 'bad pas bsgrubs pa da lta kun gyi spyod yul du gsal ba 'di bzhin no// mnga' ris mngon dga' ni rdzong dkar bla chen chodas dpal bzang pos btab/'jigs bral gyi dngos stsodab mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas dang / de'i dbon po dpal ldan seṅge sogs kyis rim pas bskyangs 'duganub ris rta sga dgon ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang g.yu brag pa chen po'i slob ma cadad kyi mtshan mtha' can gsum byung ba'i nang tshan lha phyug pa nyi zla 'od kyi dalnga sa dzā ba sangs rgyas tshal pa zhes pas btab pa nas bzung tsha pa pa bka' 35

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /brgyud pa'i ring lugs dar rgyas su byung snang / de rjes bo lugs su 'gyur/sngon dus gung thang chos sde dkar yi yan lag bu dgon gyi khongs su/ lto/nub/ gung gsum gyi nang nas mang zhig byung 'dug pa nub ris rud sogs dang sid grong gi gnas shar sogs ding sang gi bar 'dzin khongs sa gyur cing /kya bgazhan yang stod smad bar gsum du bo dong ring lugs dar tshul dang / dgon gnas kyi rnam grangs sogs shing sang dus dbang gis phal cher nyag phra zhing lo rgyus brjod pa'ang zhib tu cha ma 'tshal la yi ge'i ngal bas btang snyoms su bzhag go/ /de ltar na 'jig bral gsang ba sbyin pa'i ring lugs dang / rjes 'brel chos srid song ba po mi'i rje bo 'bar pa'i gdung rabs kyi lo rgyus rags tsam kya ba zhig skabs 'dir rim par phye ba ni de tsam mo//'dir smras pa/legs byas mngon mali dpal yon las bskyed mi bdag bsod nams brgya pa'i lha//rim byon lugs gnyis srid skyong rgya chen yon tan rgya ma'i gter mnga' bar /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ring lugs gser gyi rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa'i//dpal ldan sa 'di'i tshangs dbang 'bur pa zhes grags kun tu bsngags par 'os// 9bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser sbyangs btso ma'i khams// tshodri bral srid 'dir ches dkon yid bzhin nor//36

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med beeḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/ gangs ljongs stod 'dir kun gyi bstod bsngags yul//mi bdag rigs kyi 'phreng ba 'di las su//gang 'di'i sngon rabs da lta'i ngang tshul bar/ /ri mo'i lam du 'khod dang mgrin lam nas//brjod pa ri bong rwa yi mched zla nyid//gyur mod de phyir sngon med legs bshad yin//sngon gyon dam pa'i legs mdzad yar dpe ru//gzigs phyir sa skyong bka' yi blon snga ra bcas /rnam dkar legs byas kha 'ege gye na bsgyur ba'i//yig tshang deb ther ched du skru phra sa bskrun//rigs bral dmangs rigs khyu yi mgon po'i sar /dog tshang dregs 'gying khungs ldan khyad gsod cing //kun rdzob mu ྅)ra gtam gyis gzhan bslu ba'i//ding dus rang mtshang sngo ma dang 'di mi mtshungs//gang 'dir legs byas mngon mtho'i gser ldong gdung //37

3brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /chos srid legs tshogs mi nyams srid mtha'i bar//dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel rgyas rab brtan cing //mi mthun khyedags las rnam kun rgyal gyur cig/dpal ldan de nyid 'dus pa'i ring lugs rgya mtsho nas/ /zab gsal snying po'i yid bzhin 'dod byung rin po che//mi nub lugs gnyis rgyal mtshan rtse mor gus mchod pas//phun tshogs dge mtshan bkra shis snang bas khyab gyur cig/de ltar mi'i rje bo 'bur pa'i gdung rabs lo rgyus cha tsam brjod pa dri med beeḍūrya'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang snga rabs kyi 'o/ rgyus yig tshang mthar chags su zhib mor 'khod pa zhis mi snang bas thor bu'i lo rgyus mthong thos su gyur pa tshad ldan rnams phyogs bsdebs su bsgrigs/ bo wa nga mkhan rgyud dang mngon dga' chos sde'i lo rgyus sogs kha shas yig rnying ma tshang ba'i 'phro can zhig las btus shing / kun rdzob sgro btags kyi gtam cal sgrog gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang bar ji ltar dpyad bzod pa rnams go bde ba'i ngag gis dkyus gcig tu gsal bar byas pa ste 'di lta bu zhig yi ge'i lam du 'god par rigs so zhes chos tshobazhin du spyod pa'i sa khyodang ba'i dbang phyug rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ngadza tshul 'chang ba mi'i rje bo tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i bkas bskul ba'i ngo ra mang 38

chos ldan sa skyong 'bur pa mi rje'i gdung rabs lo rgyus dri med baiḍūrya'i 'phreng ba/du thos par rlom pa'i bya bral ba rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gam/ ming gzhan mi pham chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rang 'e/ zhe drug pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa rnam sace ski zhes pa lcags 'brug rgyal zla'i tshes 22 bzang lnga ra gangs can grub pa'i khyu mchodag dbang phyug mi la ras chen gyi grub gnas kyi yang rtse brag dkar rta so'i rtser sbyar ba kun tu don yod pa'i dge legs kyi snang ba chen pos khyab gyur cig/ dgeo'o// thugs snang dgas rgyur/brag dkar rta mo sprul sku chodas kyi dbang phyug gi bka' 'bum bris ma pod tha pa chab shog gi skor las/ 1 dpal mo chodas sdings grub chen rgyal mtshan gyi phrin las khengs dregs ko skam 'dul ba'i thod ba/ la'ang gzigs 'tshal 'o///

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /kha skong dang po/brag dkar rta so/ sprul sku chos kyi dbang phyug gi bka' 'bum bris ma dze da tha pa chab therteg gi skor las/spong rong mi rje chen dze lha sras tshe dbang rnam rgyal la phul ba lugs gnyis phun chodags dpal ster/rmad byung 'chi med bdud rtsi yis//tshe dang dpal kun rgyas mdzad pa//rgyal yum ye shes 'kho ra lo yis//lha sras khyod la shis par malnga da// phun tshogs rigs ldan 'chi med lam yang nas//legs byas bcu drug gang ba yongs rdzogs shing //mkhyen brtse'i dpag sdug ri dwags rtags kyi mdzes//lha sras zla ba gsar pa khyodad zhabs drung de//rgyal bar gyur cig su rgyu'i dbyangs kyi sgras//dge legs phun sum chosags pa'i dar dkar gyis//ba dan srid rtser 'phyar bzhin shis brjod glu// 9snyan 'gyur mgrin pa'i rol mo 'di na 'khrol//bgrangs yas chosags gnyis shar ri'i phrag pa nas//40

kha stong dang po/'gro 'di'i bsod nams skya rengs kyis bos pa'i//khyod sku nyin byed sgrib bral mtshan dpe'i gzi//gsal/༷bar chab srid phan bde padmo'i dpyid//tshe ring gnam gyi she mo nga btsan snga yis /rang rigs chos kyi rgyal thabs nor bu'i khrir//mngo na par brjid pa bkra shis gser bum ni//dge mtshan dbang gis rgyal 1rware gtsug na mdzes//skabs gsum dga' ba'i tshal nas me na kāḥches phra'i lang tsho gsar pa zla ba'i bzhin//dgyes skyed btsun mo dam par zlo sa pa'i gar //lha na cig dbang bskur thos 'dzin ro brgya'i bcud//srid na 'byor pa'i dngos wa ma tshang med//phun tshogs nam mkha'i gter gyi sgo 'phar brgya//cig car grol ba'i 'dzad med 'asnga na yodan sprin//phyogs bral kun dga'i ma11na du kun nas dkrigs// ring nas rgud pa'i gdung ba bcil ba'i gzugs//kun rtog zug rngu'i dri ma mthar bsrings nas//legs byas she shā nga gsar pa dar drag pas//skyid pa'i glu len dga' ba'i gar gyis brel//4/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /de lta'i ngo mtshar gtam snyan bdud rtsi'i ro//'o/ nya ral pa'i thor tshugs ga zha'i dbyangs//lha lam 'gengs gzod mgrin lam nas thos tshe//spro dga'i tshor ba sngo na med nyams su myong //'di na gnas kyi bskal bas ring 'gyangs kyang //yid kyi rdzing bur khyod zhal rtag par du//'char ba'i brtse gdung dngas blo'i nyer bsnyen pa'i//'bral med dam bca'i ri mo yang yang bris//gang khyod sngon benams bsod nams shing rta yis//nyer drangs mi bdag rigs kyi khang bzang du//legs byas khri 'phang mngon mthor bsnyen 'di skad/dregs ldan cher rloms 'bum gyis do zla min//de phyir bag med tha mal ngan spyod g.yos//ma gos ya rabs mdzad bzang su warṇa//blang dodar bsregs bcad brdar bas sgrungs pa yis//bsngags 'os mchodad sdong nyid du ngom par 'os//cang shes 'gyogs 'gro'i khar rtse nyag phran mdang//'thab 'dzing rdeg 'tshog myos 'gyur tha ma kha//sho rgyan 'gyed dang grogs ngan 'khor brten sogs//42

kha skong dang po/mi dbang khyod kyis rtag tu spang byar rigs//ngase ba'i bshes dang blo ldan rgan po'i 'khor/ /rngas trī/ 'grogs shing de dag khyad gsod min//snyan lha na legs bzung don bsam kun tu gzhigs// bog yangs zab cing dkyil che brtan par mdzod//phyolas re'i bsnyes spang chos srid theg dka'i khur//gnyer ba'i yum nyid bskyed byed dngos yin slos// drin shes bkur sti rim gro mched zlar bcas//byams brtse snying nye'i g.yel med byabs par 'tshal rtag tu 'bri klog grangs rtsis thos bsam dpyod/ /mchog gsum rigs kyi srung mar bcas pa la//mchod gsol sbyin sogs rnam dkar dge tshogs spel//mnga' 'bangs thabs mkhas thugs rjes skyongs bar mdzod//mi shigs rdo rjes srung ba'i sding khang du//yid kyi thig ler gzhon nu khyod rtsen par//legs tshogs spel ba'i thabs tshul 'dir 'bad bzhin//zab bzhes rnam kun g.yel med mdzod cig kyi//de skad lhag bsam dag pa'i yid//dung dang zla ba ku mu tar//43

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /mtshungs pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun//khyod thugs yodal gor 'khyil bar 'os//khyodad sku mi shigs sku ga gi ka ba ni//srid pa ji srid g.yo med rdo rje'i khams //ji bzhin rab brtan chodas srid sde bzhi'i dpal//mdzad 'phrin phan bde'i dpal yon 'bar gyur cig/ dge'o//

kha skong gnyis pa /brag rdzun kur rta so sprul sku chos kyi dbang phyug gi bka' 'bum bris ma ngo da tha pa chab shog gi skor las/spong rong du chos bzhin sa la spyod pa'i dbang phyug mi rje tshe dbang rnam rgyal la btsun mo khab bzhes skabs legs 'bul gyi skyes dang bcas phul ba sde bzhi'i legs tshogs sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i lde mig/dpal sa skyong chos kyi rgyal sngo mi rje lha sras gachodan nu phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba btsun mo dam par bcas pa'i zhabs drung du/ maṅga waṃ susti' sarba arathā siddhi rasru zhes dge legs su bya ba'i me rtog lan brgyar 'thor zhing shis pa brjod pa'i bden tshig rgya cher brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dngas ba chen pos mngon par btud de zhu gsol/ de yang / 'jig rten gsum na phan bde'i rtsa lag gcig pur gyur pa rgyal ba shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che dar shing rgyas pa dang / de 'dzin gyi skyes chen 'phags mchog phyag na padmo ngur smrig gar gi ro la pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs yab sras sogs yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ris su ma chad pa'i rnam par 'dren pa rnams zhabs pad brtan pa dang /lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams thugs mthun zhing chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo gsum sogs legs byas kyi dpal yon gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po gnam bskos lhas skyong 'jam 45

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal mee long / mgon gong ma bdag po'i dbus no ra 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba'i rje bo dang de'i kha 'o/ ba rnams ྅kyi tshe brtan cing chab srid rgyas pa/ bsil ldan gyi ra ba dkar pos khor yug tu bskor ba'i bod ljongs mtha' dbus thams cad du nad mug 'khrug rtsod mtha' yi dmag tshogs la sogs ming gi rgud pa mtha' dag zhi nas char chu dus 'beb/ lo phyugs rtag legs sogs bde skyid dpal la longs su spyod pa'i skabs nas/ 'dir dge legs yon tan ma lus pa'i gzhir gyur pa ni sngon byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu don thams cad 'grub pa sgru 'phrul lha mo'i rtsibs logs las bltams pa dang mtshungs par mngal gyi dri ma sku ngas su spangs pa lha yi lha 'bur pa zhes chos kyi rgyal po'i rigs dang / bod yul du 'dir che zhing mtho la btsun pa'i mi'u gdung drug tu grags pa'i ya gyal gser ldong ser po'i gdung rabs tshar du dngar ba las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad gsang gsum thugs rje'i zlos gar lnga brgya'i mun sel sgron me thub bstan yongs cadags kyi shing rta chen sngo dpal 'jigs med grags pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba gang gi ring lugs mnyam med bo dong pa zhes snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'dzin ma'i khyon kun sku ngas su khyab par grags shing /'jigs bral gyi slob dpon chen po rang nyid kyi gdan seng ge'i khri chen po srung zhing chos srid 'khor los sgyur ba'i byed por bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'gran zla dang bral ba du ma dang / chos bzhin lha nga ba'i mi'i rje bo stodabs dang ldan pa bgrang ba las 'das pa du ma zhig byon te rje 46

kha skong gnyis pa/dasngo na nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi 'phreng ba zam mi chad par brgyud pa las phul du byung ba'i mkhyen rab dang / tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid bka' drin //tshungs pa ma mchis pa'i byang dzaṭīb sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yab rje chos kyi rgyal wa nam mkha' tshe dbang bstan 'dzin de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sras phun sum chodags pa'i rigs rus chod 'brangs gtsang ma las bltams shing / rmad du byung ba'i yon tan du mas spras pa lha sras mi'i rje bo gzhon nur gyur pa 'jigs bral nam mkha' tshe dbang rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde zhes mtshan gyi dge mtshan dang ldan pa 'di nyid rang rigs kyi chos srid skyong ba'i byed por nor bus bteg pa'i khri 'phang mthon wa'i blar rgyal thabs kyi cod pan dkar po gtsug tu bcings te lha dang bcas pas dbang bskur zhing / dus 'dir sngon byon rigs kyi 'phreng ba gong mar gyur pa rnams kyis 'jig rten grags sde dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa dang rjes su sa ba pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gdung rabs kyi 'phreng ba chab srid dang bcas pa 'di nyid srid pa ji srid kyi bar du mi nyams par bya ba dang / 'khor 'o/sa sgyur ba'i rgyal po la rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun mdun du bdar ba dper mtshon pa'i thun mong du rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa thams cad cha tshang bar bya ba'i phyir g.yas ru byang mang mkhar pa'i char se dkar rigs kyi thig le mdar mi rje sde srid rin po che'i rigs kyi sras mo btsun mo dam par dbang bskur te bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan phun tshogs dpal gyi 'byor pa rgya chen the/sa khab tu bzhes par/ phyogs bcu'i zhing 47

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rab 'byams nas rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa gsum bka' sdod dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs shing / chos srung nor lha dkar phyogs skyong bar byas pas srung skyob spel ba dang / lha rnams kyi shis brjod pa'i me tog gi char lan brgyar 'bebs shing / skye rgu mchog dman bar par bcas pa'i ltos bcas yid can mi'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi legs gso'i brten 'byung phun tshogs dpal dang 'byor pa'i dngos po ma tshang med par 'phyur por spungs pa'i mdun sar/ gang gi thugs rje chen po nye bar 'tsho ba'i bdag cag ri sul dben pa gyi nar gnas pa bya bral rnal 'byor spyod pa brag dkar bas kyang gzhan khrel gyi khyu las ring du song phyir 'khos med nyams chung zang zing 'byor stobs kyis dben pa'i phra mor gyur pa zhig na'ang lhag bsam gyi rtsa ba ches sgom pas dngos 'bul brten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag gi mtshon byed tsam du bsnyen bkur gsol ja/bzhes 'bras/ mchod chang phran bu bcas spyan sngar bstar ba'i thog /bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dri ma med pa rab dkar srid du ring bar/nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs//nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing //nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog/ces pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo macadan par bkra bas mtshon pa'i mgul dar/ na bza'/ btsun mo rin po 48

khu sgong gnyis pa/cher mgul dar gong mtshungs/ na bza'/ yum rin lnga/ cher mgul dar/ mtshan grangs/ a ce lags ྅kyi mched la mgul dar/ mtshan grangs/ ྅kyi zhang sde pa sna/ dpon sku zhabs su mgul dar/ mtshan grangs/ gnyer las byed so sor mgul dar/ mtshan grangs bcas 'bul lam zhus pa dngo sa 'bul za cadag gi skud pa ltar ches cher phra yang dgyes pa'i spyan zur yang por btsa' ba nas slar yang zhu ba/ 'jig rten 'di na bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi rten thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin dang bcas pa dang / sa spyod chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi'i rje bo rnams la rag lus shing khyad par 'jig med gsang ba sbyin pa'i ring lugs de nyid 'dus pa'i bshad sgrub kyis bstan pa rin po che dang de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde spong rong mnga' 'bangs lha mi'i sde ltos par bcas pa mtha' dag gi re ltos kyi brten sa gcig pu gnyis su med par grub bzhin dus 'dir zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du gachodam med rdo rje'i khri la gasku ba med par sku tshe dang ye shes mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa/ mkhyen rab rnam dpyod blo spyodas la mes wa tshangs pa/ snying stobs kyi rtsal la byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa chen khrod/ dpal 'byor 'dzad med nam mkha'i mdzod chen por mnga' ba rnam thos kyi bu/ rigs rus sras kyi 'phreng ba zam mi chad cing bgrangs yas pa 'khor los sgyur ba rtsibs kyi mu 'khyud/ phas rgol gzhan sde'i rgol ba ma lus pa 'jo mas pa ra ma ṇa/ mnga' 'bangs dge bcu'i khrims kyi bde bar skyong zhing 'phral yun phan bde'i thar pa'i lam bzang por dkri 49

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long / ba la mi rje srong btsan sgam po lta bu dang rnam thar mtshungs par mnyam pa'i thugs bskyed mdzad 'phrin dang / chos srid chab 'bangs dang bcas pa'i phan bde'i legs tshogs mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma chad de srid kyi bar du mi chad par gong nas gong du chu gter chen po rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng bzhin 'phel zhing brten par smon pa lags na tshul ji bzhin par yid kyi re 'bras bde blag tu 'grub pa dang lhan cig bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs bar chad mi mthun pa'i g.yul thams cad rab tu bcom ste de dag las rnam par rgyal zhing bkra shi sa pa'i bde legs dge mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam pa thams cad sar phyogs dus kun tu bde zhing bkra shis par gyur cig dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ zhes mnga' ris gung thang smad kyi ljongs kha ba ri pa'i grub brgyud pa kun gyi gtsug nor dbang phyug mi la ras pa tshe gcig la mngon par byang chub pa'i bsti gnas sa la spyod pa'i 'og min brag dkar rta so dbu ma rdzong gi ri ngogs nas rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas lan grangs brgya phrag tu brjod pa 'di kun nas don dang ldan par gyur cig/sarba maṅga waṃ/ /50

kha ska nga gsum pa/brag dkar rta mo sprul sku chodas kyi dbang phyug gi bka' 'bum bris ma pod tha pa chab shog gi skor las/ spong rong du chos bzhin du sa skyong ba mi rje chen po yab rje tshe dbang bstan 'dzin de nyid la phul ba snyan tshig gi 'phreng ba'i sarga dang po//si༅/ /su'i/ rab dkar mdzes sku blta bas ngoms bral kun gsal ngos//mtshan dpe'i chu 'dzin dra bas nyer khebs gsung gsang gis// dbyar gyi rnga bsangs dal bur bskul las blo gros char// rtsol mdzad lha mo mtsho ldan ma kyi bdag skyongs mdzod//bsod nams rgya mtsho'i 'jings las nyer 'phags mi bdag 'kho ra lo'i dbang phyug lhan po'i rgyal//sde bzhi'i dpal gyis bang rim mngon mthod phun chodags sa gsum sku ngas kyi gter gyu ra pa//nges legs srid zhi'i rtse mor rab 'phags bsngags 'os lhar bcas ma lus thams cad kyis//shis brjod zla nyi 'char nub bral ba'i bden pas nyer bsnyen dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig/gang gi thugs rje'i char sprin rab rgyas pa'i//5/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long zegs mas snying la yang yang bran gyur pas//slo gros myu gu snying pa'ang lang tsho'i bzi //gsal byas dbyar gyi dpal mo'i dga' stodan gyur//'kho ra ba'i zhen 'dzin tshang tshing nags kyis dben//phyogs re'i kun slong brag zur gca' 'phrang med/ /lta ngan 'o/ga pa'i g.yang sa bral gyur pa'i//slo bde'i dpal thang yangs pa'i chos der smon//'on te kha bshad mu cor rdzun ham sgras//yang dag wa na gyi gnyid thabs chag gyur cing //grong 'khyams kun tu rgyu ba'i khyi rgan dang //bya bral gzhon nu'i mdun ma rnam dbyer min//ring nas ngan bo mas bag yangs spyodad pa'i shugs//gab par ma nus rang nyams ston byed cing //snang ba gdong 'de da hur 'thum u tshugs kyis//gzhan bsun 'byin pa'i glang rgan 'di skad lo//dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i rnam dpyod 'dzum dkar mig/mi ldan bzhin du'ang yin chodam bzang brdzu'i ngang //nang khrol ltad mor ngom pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis//gzhan yid brid bce na lus phra kho warware gtam//52

kha tsāong gsum pa/phyi nas char sprin g.yo ba'i char gyis brlan//nang du ja chang bza' btung rgyun gyis brlan//bar du rang rgyud dkor nyon dug chus brlan//khron pa'i sbal ba'i mched zla bdag kho na//skyes sbyang skusten tan sgyu rtsal mi mkhas shing // don gnyis thabs kyis lo na pa go ma stabs dbul//chos bshad mun pa'i mda' 'phen gar phog med//tsha drag sgyu ma'i zlos gar bdag gis bsgyur//de lta'i rang tshul gyi na'i brtul zhugs 'di//dam pa'i mdun sar mdzes min skal mnyam gyis//gdol spyod thal pa byis pa dga' ba'i skyes//mnyam 'grogs blun po'i khrod du bor bar rigs//mang mang kun la brtse ba'i spyan ras can//mang mang shes bya kun gzigs dzadas kyi rgyal//mang mang shan gyi spyi watware mdzes rgyan drung //mang mang kho bos brjod pa ga la 'os//snyan 'gyur yan lag 'bum ldan dri za'i glu//legs bshad dbyangs su 'bab pa mkhas pa'i lugs//grong tshigs rang dgar rkang pas gcad pa'i gzugs//

'brog sde chen po spo rong bi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long / blun po'i snar snyan dpyod ldan su zhig mgu//gang yang 'di na legs bshad tshig ni byis pa dag las len 'os zhes//sngon rabs la grags de slad 'dir yang ldog med lung gi dbugs 'byin ltar//ji tsam bajo da pa'i gtam gyi phyu ra ba tshig skyes ma li gsar pa ni//'phral du nyams dga'i mgrin pa mdzes byed rim gyis grangs su spel bar byas//zhes gang shar chu 'babs su bsnyad pa'i mu cor tshig gi 'phreng ba ci dgar spel ba smyon pa'i zlos gar thog mar rang bzhin brjod kyi nyams dga' tsam du rang tshul sgra ji bzhin par dbyangs su gyer pa'i sarga dang wakhedi// 'phro gzhag/ sarba maṅga waṃ// //

kha skong bzhi pa/kha skong bzhi pa/ dwag dkar rta so sprul sku chodas kyi dbang phyug gi bka' 'bum bris ma pod tha pa chab cadag gi skor las/spo rong mi rje chen po rje dngo na tshe dbang rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i zhal gdams snyan bskul tshangs pa'i rnga chen bzhugs//oṃ sug/ nges par 'gro 'di thugs rjes mi gtong zhing //gang la gsol btab 'dod rgu'i 'bras wer ba'i//bslu med mchog gsum yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha//sa bdag khyod nyid yun du skyongs bar mdzod// 1lugs gnyis kun dang 'di phyi 'phral yun du// blang dang dor bya'i legs bshad mu tig 'phreng / /don bzang snyan 'jeb mdzes pa'i phra snuram can/ /'di spo bag yod mgul ba'i rgyan du bzhes// 2srid dang rigs kyi mngon par 'ophags gyur pa//sa skyang gzhan las khyad zhugs ga 'phang can//chos kyi rgyal pos dal thabs rim bzhin du//'dzin par snyan bskul ma sgrib gsal bar 'doms// 355

'brog sde chen po go rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long shing sang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mthar gtugs shing //bod ljongs nad yams mu ge khral rigs kyis/ /mnar zhing lugs gnyis srol bzang phal cher nub// rgya bod 'dres pa'i lugs srol 'chal por spyod// 4gang la'ang yid brtan bral ba'i dus skabasa'o dir// sngan byung ya rabs lugs mthun gtam brjad pa//zhwa dpe lham 'gebs gzhan gyi snar gas na yang //lhag bsam dge bas brjod la skyon yod min// 5bod kyi dawa na skya drung 'kho ra phal cher mugs //mi sde kun 'joms sdig dang g.yo sgyu'i las// lhar len de dag ring dor de 'dra'i tshul//ma 'dres dzadas rgyal lha nga ma'i dper gzigs 'tshal// 6bla ma chos brgyud sel med mtshan ldan la//bsten na dam pa'i sku na tan ngang gis 'go //zog 'khyal rdzun gter log khyodad mi dge ba'i// gyi bshes gnyen ring spang bar ma btang snyoms bzhag/ 756 tshe

la skong bzhi pa/mchog gsum rten bzhengs gus pas rtag tu mchod//dge 1ba'i bshes dang yon tan mkhan rnams bkur//dpo na skya rgan po blo ldan drung 'khor brten//'khos chung nyam thag nye ring brtse bas skyongs// 8'bangs 'khor kun la sgyu dang gzan cha'i tshogs//thabs mkhas lha nas ci chung mdzad pa dang //bag med rta rgyug tho co'i rtsed 'jo'i rigs//myos gyur gzhan gyi bud med g.yem sdu/gas spangs// 9 mnga' 'bangs drag pos tsha brjid non pa'i phyir//khrims 'gal nyes bya sa tshar gcad 'os yin kyang //srog phra 'dimig dang55na lag gasgu da 'dreg sogs//sdig chen gas la thab sa kyis 17la ba gces// 10 snyed dka'i dal rten yun du 'tsho ba'i thabs rang nyid tshe dpag med dang sgrol mdzad yum//yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rgyun khyer tshe sgrub dang //bgegs 'joms rta mgrin lha yi rnal 'byor brtson// 1157

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rnying bshags yan lag bdun dang sangs rgyas mtshan//bka' 'gyur ro cog sgrol ma mtshan brgyad dang //sdig sgrib kun 'joms gzungs sogs phan yon can// ( ) 12bsang mchod klu gtor bskur bsngo rigs sung gi//chos skyong gsol mchod gsol 'debs le'u bdun//bsam lhan bar chad lam sel smon lam sogs//gzhis byes kun dang chibs thog zhal 'don mjo da// 13zla rer lha bsang chos skyong bskang bshags dang //ri mtho rlung dar 'dzugs shing yar mar gyi//tshes bcu chag med 'dzin cing gzhan la'ang bskul//dus kyi rim gro phyi bshol mi g.yel 'tshal// 14zhi rgyas dbang drag las tshogs che phra kun//khungs ldan phyag sredal rnam dag tshul bzhin du//nyams su bstar ba'i mchodad gnas rten 'os maro///gzhan du rgyu gron rang gzhan ngal ba'i rgyu// 1558

'grog sdechenapo sporangagi byungababarjodaspradwangasagasala'achu/nganade skad lhag bsam dri bral dbang gzhu'i mdangs//blang dor phon brgyas phye ba'i tshig 'phreng 'di//rnam kun dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor chub pa yi//don gnyis phan bde'i dpal gyis skyong mdzod kyi// 36'di las thosnab pa'i dge cho gas ci mchis pas//chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi bdag zhabs brtan cing //tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs zogs dbyar mas ltar//'phel rgyas mnga' thang chab srid yun brtan shog/ 37ces pa'i rab tu phyed pa'i snyan bskul tshangs pa'i rnga chen zhes pa 'di ni lugs gnyis dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i sa yi tshangs dbang lha nga rong nas mi rje chen po rje dbon tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyi bzhed pa bskang phyir brag dkar ba chos kyi dbang phyug gam ming gzhan mi pham 'chi med grub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal ba zhes pa'i shing 'o/ rta lo'i khrums zla'i yar tshes dge bar bris nas phul ba don sku da pa'i zhags pas kun yid 'ching ba dam pa'i spyod pas mchog tu mdzes pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ dge'o// //64

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rjes mthar gzhung bzhin jo gas pa'i rim par bsdu//lus srang the ra dkyil sems dkyil gang bde 'cha'//mnyam bzhag mig gnyis sna rtser drang thad lta//dbugs ni rang bab so ma lhag par bzhag/sems gnad dus gsum rtog pa'i 'a'o/ 'du bcad//gnas 'gyu gnyis med dran reg ngo bo ni//ma yengs mi sgoms ma bcos lda/ga par bzhag/gsal stong bsnyu da bral smra bsam yul las 'das//ma brjed ngo bo rjen pa hrig ge skyongs//de la stong lta had po dran med dang //bying rmugs thib dang rgod pa'i skyon spangs nas//bying na lta gdangs spang bstod rigs ngar skyed//rgod na lhod lod sgrim lod skyong shes bya//kun gzhi ming 'aro/gas tha snyad bral ba yi//sems nyid gdod nas rtsa bral 'dus ma byas//skye 'gag gnas med rang rigs rang gsal ba//gzhi 'bras dbyer med dodan dam chos sku nyid//de nyid rtogs na gzhan du rtsol skrub dang //re dogs mi bya rang bab skyong ba la//68
