'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /snying gtam bdud rtsi gang shar tshig 'phreng 'ga'//spel 'di snga na sems lag len rgyud khrel mdzodad//dge des rnam mkhyen bo 'phang myur babo da shog/ces pa 'di yang khyim spyod slo ldan dad pa'i dpal ldan sa rong rgan chen a jo tshe dbang dpal rgyas kyi ring mo nas yang yang nan gyis bskul ba'i g.yar khral tsam du bya bral ba chos kyi dbang phyug gis bris pa don dang ldan par gyur cig/ //

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re gar bzhugs 'dir phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/chos brgyud ris med kyi dpe cho gas gcig tu bzhugs pa'i dpe maX da khang gi mthun rkyen mi 'asprodams pa'i rigs dang / rang 'dra'i skal mnyam 'ga' la phan du re nas bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re gar bzhugs 'dir phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa lags/1 de yang 'bo sa lo ga'o/na nu dpal gyis 1476 'o/ra mjug sku ngas su snyu gas par mdzad pa'i deb gter sngon po'i deb ther sngon po/ smad cha/ si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1984 dum bu bcu pa/ dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i skabs kyi cadag grangs 920las/ yang stag sde ba la mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang blo gro sa brtan pas gsan te/ 'di ni me pho byi ba la la stodad lho'i gyam du sku 'khrungs/ yum snga mor grongs nas lug gi 'o mas gsos/ sku phra ba'i dus su chos rje byang gling pa dang grub chen ༷/ rgyan pa gnyis kyis 'di la dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po zhig 'ong gsungs nas bskyangs/ dgung 'o/ bdun pa la mkhan chen gser khang pa'i drung du me ston 'dul 'dzin dang gnyis la rab tu byung nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa bslabs/ bcu gsum pa la bshad gsar mdzad/ de nas stag sde ba'i snyan pa gsan nas tsha snar byedan te/ stag sde ba la sngags mtshan nyid kyi sde snyadad mang 7/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /du gsan/ khyad par dus 'kho ra mkhas par bslabs/ bcu dgu bzhes pa'i tshe stag sde ba gshegs nas lo tsā ba mchog ldan la ka lā pa dang tsand+ra pa bslabs/snyan dngags me 'o/nga yang gsan/ a tsa ra 'phrad tshad la 'phral skad bslabs/yud tsam gyis zhu chen gyi pho tsā bar gyur/ bal por yang lan bdun byon/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi gzhung shin tu mang po la gzhi 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos mdzad/ tshad ma dang mngon pa la sku gas pa'i ṭīkka yang mang du brtsams/ mdor na khong rang zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe kho nga las mgo 'phang malnga ba'i mkhas pa su yang med/ phyis dbus su byon nas ne'u thog /gung thang / stag lung la sogs pa rnams su sde sdod 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa'i blo'i mig phyes/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched la sogs pa'i dpal sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud chen sngo rnams kyis kyang chos gsan pa las gzhan pa'i tshe'ang gong du bkur/ bo dong e'i gdan sa yang lnga gas shig mdzad/ chogs kyi rje bamo da nams rgyal mtshan pas dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i rgyud 'grel gyi lung gsan pa na/ khyed kyis 'di la nan tan che ba zhig mdzod cig gsung ba'i bka' nan yang gnang / gnas po cher yun ring du bzhugs nas rang gi mkhyen pa rnams la bshad pa yang mang du mdzad/ nyin dang mtshan du thugs dam las kyang mi g.yel/ snyan pas kyang stod ya tse dang /smad rgya'i yul gyi bar du khyab/ gzhan don gyi bya ba rdzogs nas drug cu rtsa bdu na pa chu rngo rta'i 'o/ la zhi bar gshegs/ mkhas pa dpang lo nyid kyi dbon po dpal ldan byang chub rtse mos gsan te/ de yang chu mo yos la la stod lhor 'khrungs/72

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/chung ngu nas rje btsun dpang gi zhabs la thug nas sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams dang / legs par sbya ra ba'i skad la mkhas shing rig pa'i gnas phra smu rnams la'ang byang bas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo dang ldan te/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bkas bo dong gi gdan sa yang mdzad/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gong du 'byon no ba'i phyag phyir stag lung gi bar du byon pas/ stag lung rin po che ranā ka ras/ lo tsā ba rtse mo 'di nged kyi dbon po'i slob dpon du gnang ba zhu zhes dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la zhus pas/ de bzhin du byas pas chog gsungs nas gnang / da3/na po nam mkha' dpal bzang sngo/ zhes grags pa de yang yu mo'i sras dharme shī ra'i sku'i skye ba yin cing / sngon gyi tshul rnams kyang gsal por dran/ de la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa dang / chos gzhan yang rtse mo/sa mang du gnang bas nam mkha' dpal bzang pa yang mkhas pa chen wa zla med par gyur te/ sna ma pa yang mang du mdzad/ phyis stag lung gi gdan sar bzhugs nas kyang gdan sa de bkra shis dpal brtsegs pa la phog /thang lha mdzod ces pa'i gzims khang du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs sku / /phyis 'o/ chen gyis yar klungs dang / gad na sa thel/ gung thang du bzhugs nas dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o/ la sdugegs pa'i chos kyi char gyis mkhas pa mang po tshims par mdzad/ khyad par du spyan snga grags pa byang chub pas chos mang du gsan/ lo chen 'di nyid mtshan du bsnyen sgrub kyi rnal 'byor las mi g.yel ba gzigs pas/ de dang mthun par spyan snga nas gzims chung du mun 73

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me longakamatshams bsdams te thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad wa / de nas gtsang phyogs la khyodan te/ chu mig ring mo ra bzhugs nas gdul bya mang lnga smin ༷ la la bkod de bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo la zhi bar gshegs so//'o/ chen 'di'i slob ma sgra tshad dus kyi 'kho ra lo la mkhas pa'i 'o/ tsā ba nam mkha' bzang 10sa kyang 'o/ chen gyi phyag phyi dang / sa gzhan du yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa mang du mdzad do/ /lo chen 'di'i dbon po pho tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / de'i dbo na po dpal 'jigs med grags pas kyang bla ma snga ma rnams kyi srol gzung zhing mkhas pa'i bya bas gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad de bstan pa'i bdag por gyur to/ /'jigs med grags pa 'di ni/ shing mo sku sa la 'khrungs nas bdun cu rtsa bdun lcags mo lug la gshegs/ chu mo glang la 'khrungs par 'dod pa yang sku da dod/ /zhes gsal/rin mkhas pa'i dbang wa shel dkar ba ngag dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos 1732lor mdzad pa'i shel dkar chos 'byung legs bshad nor bu'i me long skal bzang mgrin rgyan zhes bya ba dbu can bris ma phyo ga ldeb 34bzha las/ shel dkar chos sde dpal gyi sde chen dga' ldan legs bshad gling / zhes snyan par grags pa 'dir mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar ba'i gzhi ma mkhan rgyud ji ltar byon pa'i tshul la/ sngon dus grwa tshang nyer gcig mo gas kyi skabs su mkhan rgyud ji ltar byon tshul dang / zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan 74

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/pa'i ring lugs mkhad gtsang btsugs nas mkhan rgyud ji ltar byon tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon dus lto brgyud bdag po don yod dpal pho brang rgyal khom rin chen spo na bzhugs dus rgyal mo ri'am sgrol ma ri'i zhabs pus gasku na pa skyil steng na legs shing pa'i sgrub gnas dbo na chung zhig sku da par dpang 'o/sa phebs nas gdan sa byin gyis brlabs shing / sa gnas der bshad grwa btsugs na dar rgyas chen po yodang ba'i lung bstan bcas lho bdag don yodad dpal bzang la bshad grwa 'dzugs dbo sa pa'i bka' gnang yang re zhig 'dzugs ma thub par/slar yang lo chen byang rtses dpang lo'i lung bstan bcas lho bdag don yod dpal bzang la bshad grwa 'dzugs dgos pa'i bka' gnang yang re zhig 'dzugs ma thub par slar yang lo chen byang rtses dpang lo'i lung bstan bcas ta si chos rin la bka' gnang nas bshad grwa btsugs pa'i mkhan wa'i lnga ga ma 'o/ chen grags pa yin yang / snga morware dgon phran de'i gdan sar dpang 'o/ yab sras bzhugs 'dug pas de'i phyir shel dkar gyi mkhan po'i thodag mar dpang 'o/sa mdzad pa sngon du grags shing rig pas kyang 'thad par rtogs nas jog mar shel dkar chos dpon dang dpang snyedan mkhas pa'i dbang po slo gros brtan pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus brjod pa ni/ ji skad du/rlo chen rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ma ༷ sa mtshor//legs 'khrungs bstan pa'i 'khor lo dzam bu'i ljon//legs bshad gnas lnga rig pa'i yal 'dab can//

'brog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dpang ston mkhas pa'i dbang wa ra gso/la ba 'debs//zhes pa'i bsngags brjod don ldan du gyur pa dpang yo tsā ba chen po slo gros brtan pa de nyid ni/ sku tshe dpag par dka' ba nas mahā paṇḍi ta ches che ba zhig ste/ sngon tshe sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /gzhung rnams rtsed mo'i zhor la shes/zhes de nyid rang gis gsungs pa ltar sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni zur rtso'i gyam zhes par/ me pho byi ba'i lo sku 'khrungs shing de 'phral yum dang bral nas chung ngu la ma mo6re cod mas gaskunas pas/ zhal snga nas mi blun lnga rnams kyis khe/ bo la ba yi cad ma byin na legs pa yin pa la/ ma smasare cod ma byin pas bye 11sa kyi phyed 'grib tu bcug ces yang yang gsungs/ de'i skabs su yum gyi spun zla bsru mo gcig gis/ bla ma tse/ rgyan pa'i drung du phyin nas bu chung zhig nyog pas byin rlabs srung mdud cig zhu byas pas/ bla ma'i gsung nas bu chung de la dge bshes chen po zhig sku/nga bar 'dug pas 'di byin gsungs nas/ ja bzhes 'phre'i gsol zhal dang bcas pa bskur ba gnang ngo / /dgung lo gsum bzhi'i dus su btsun chung lu gu zhes mi rnams 'bod ro// /dgung 'o/ lnga pa la rgyal ba rgod tshang pa chen po'i gdan sa bar 'brog rdor gling gi gdan sa pa/ rin po che byang gling pa'i drung du byon nas dge bsnyen skrub par mdzad pas rin po che gsung gis 'di la dge bshes chen wa zhig 'byung gsungs nas/ bzhugs stan gyi steng du bzhag/ mtshan blo gros brtan par btags sku / /der lo gnyis drung du bzhugs/ dgung lo bdun pa la mkhan chen gser khang pa dang me'u 'dul 'dzin gnyis las rab 76

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/tu byung nas 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs bslabs/ yab kyis kyang dge snyadang byas te dge slong byang sems zhes bya ba shin tu btsun par grags so/ /dgung 'o/ ba ce pa'i dus su nga la 'dul ba bya ṭika dang bcas pa khyi ma bu bdun gyis bdas kyang thon pa yod gsungs/ de'i dus su mchod pa'i gzhi la gdan 'dren mang po byung bas/ chu la ma thar ba la grogs mched rgan pa 'dras chu la khur bas/khyed la stobs chen po 'dug sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ring po khur bas theg 'gro bar 'dug gsungs pas/ chu rgal ba'i dus chu dkyil du bskyur bas stod 'gag gi gong ba la 'jus pas chu la ma tshar ba chu thon pa dang khur mi de na re ngas khyod chu la ma thar ba sgral bas/ khyod lnga sa kha po che ba la zer skad do/ /bcu gsum pa la bshad gsar mdzad nas chodas byang zer ba mdzad do/ /de nas sa skya'i phyogs su byon/ der zhag 'ga' bzhugs nas dri ba mdzad pas bla ma stag sde ba'i snyan pa gsan te/ tsha snar byon nas bla ma de'i drung du thog mar mngon pa bslabs nas bcu drug pa la gsungs/ de nas phar tshad sbrags nas bslabs shing bco brgyad pa la gnyis ka gsungs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o/ yang bslabs/ phal chen dang sa sde sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i lugs dang / sems skyed sogs chomang du zhus/ dbu ma yang gsan te 'di skad gsungs/ phyi nang gsang gsum don ldan pa'i//rgyud 'grel tshig don rab bshad nas / rdo rje theg par blo phyogs mdzad//

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gsang ba'i don ston bla mar 'dud//chos kun spro sa pa kun bral yang //sgyu ma lta bur ji lta'i don//rig pas slo yul nges par mdzod//chos zab don ston bla mar 'dud//ces gsung zhing tshad ma kun las btus pa legs par bslabs te lo drug bar ma chad du bsten te bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mkhyen te/sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'phrin las kyis//rgyal ba las kyang ches lhag par//bdag la phan bde ches mang bsgrubs//'dren mchog bla ma de la 'dud//bsam zhing bla ma 'di bka' drin che//stag sde ba 'di bka' drin che//seng ge rgyal mtshan 'di bka' drin che//bka' drin can gyi bla ma la//gus par phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi//zhes sogs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad/ dgung lo ba cu dgu pa'i dus su bla ma stag sde ba sku bshegs/ de phyin chad lo mchod ma chag par mdzad/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis bka' drin ches che ba'i bla ma stag pa mchod gsungs nas shin 78

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/tu mo sa gus checad//de nas mang mkhar khra tshang du bla ma mchodag ldan pa'i drung du cadan nas/ ston de 7 gā pa dang / tsand+ra pa'i byings dang / snyan ngag me 'o/nga gsan nas/ dgun de sa skyar gyon nas bla ma 'jam skya ba la rtag gnyis/ rnam 'grel rig gter rnams gsan sna / /dpyid ka mkhan chen gser khang pa'i drung du khyodan nas bsnyen par rdzogs te/ ka ri ka khong gi ṭīkka dang bcas pa gsan/ sems skyed bslab btus maro/ sde rgyan dang mngon rgyan la sku gas pa chodas mang du gsan te/ lngas kyang ma sngas gser khang pa dang mjal/ /phyis kyang ma phyis gser khang pa dang mjal/ /zhes gsungs shing gro mdzad cing shin tu mo sa gus che'o/ /mkhan po'i gsung gis slo brtan khyod la lo tsā ba chen po zhig 'ong zhes gsungs nas lung bstan mdzad do/ /slob dpon me'u 'dul 'dzin la so sor thar pa'i mdo/skyes rabs dang spyod 'jug rnams legs par bslabs shing gzhan yang chos mang du gsan te/ tshigs gnyis kyi slob dpon zhus so/ /slo ba dpon stodabs la'ang gsang ston sku gas chodas mang du zhus mo / /de nas sa skyar drodan nas bla ma cadangs ston pa'i dbon po la sgra ka lā pa dang / tsand+ra pa/ me long 'chi med mdzod rnams kyi phyag dpe g.yar nas bris te/ a tsa ra byung tshad la 'phral skad sbyangs nas lto bal la 'byon pa'i grabs mdzad do/ /bar skabs der dus mchod kyi rol mo 'dzin cing / sgra'i slob gnyer mdzad pas shin tu 'phel lo/ bla ma bzhi thog pa dang paṇḍi ta'i bar gyis 'o/ tsā ba'i mtshan de nas grags so/ /dpag bsam 'khri 79

'grog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /shing gis mchan bu mdzad/ bstod pa rgyan gyi 'phreng ba nyin gcig la mdzad nas rtogs shing pa la bskur bas de dang chos bzang gis gser srang gang dang gos phyi nang phul ba de dag bsnams nas dgung lo nyer gcig pa la bal por byon nas/rā ma ṇa ā tsarya dang / ma da ṇa ā tsarya la sgra tsand+ra pa gsan no/ /de nas dbyar sa skyar byon nas btsas ma'i dus su ka lā pa'i 'gyur mdzad nas/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir legs bshad kyi dga' ston kyi'o/ /'gyur byang du/shongs ston legs bshad lde mig blangs//legs sbyar skad kyi gnyer kha phye//sna tshogs gzhung lugs rin chen blangs//legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed la dbang // zhes sogs 'gyur byang du bkod par mdzad/ rtogs shing pa la bstodad pa rgyan gyi 'phreng ba gnang ba'i lan du zhu shog tu/ rtogs shing tshigs su bcad pa/ rgya gar bal por lus g.yo zhing //blo gros shes bya'i tshogs la g.yo//legs sbyar skad la ngag g.yo yang //rab tu brtan pa'i mtshan 'dzin pa//skad gnyis smra ba yud tsam dgongs//zhes sku gas kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang dngul bre gang bcas pa byung ba rnams nas slar yang bal por byon/ /slob gnyer gyis zhor la rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs kyi 80

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/thang sku dang dpe cha mang du bzhengs/ /tsand+ra pa'i yig sna mdzad/ spyir btang dang dam pa rtog dkar bsgyur/ dgongs rgyan dang rgyal dbang blo sku gas kyi 'gyur gyi mgo btsugs so/ /yang sa skyar dre na nas phal cher la ma dgyes par dge slong phal cher 'du 'dzi 'dod cing dam pa'i chos la don gnyer zhan/ skye bo phal cher ngo tsha khrel yod bral zhing sdig to sna snu gas sgrub/ /mkhas chodam phal cher yun ring sbyangs pa'i gzhung gi'ang de nyid mi rig cing / legs bshad gsar pa'i skyesarno maso nan gyis bkral yang len pa su yang med/bstan pa dar 'dad phyags na yang //skye dgu'i gnas lugs 'di 'dra'o//lus can kun la bde gshegs kyis//snying po yod ces dag snang sbyangs//zhes gsungs sku// /mig ser gyi snyung gzhi byung bas mnal bsrung ba'i ched du mig ser gyi rtogs brjod shin tu snyan tshig gsal bar mdzad cing / bla ma 'jam skya bas phebs dus bsu ba ser sgreng byas nas bsnyen bkur chen po mdzad skad/ sgra la sogs pa slob gnyer ba mang du byung na'ang slar yang bal po dang rgya gar du lan bdun gyi bar du byon no/ /sgra tsand+ra pa'i 'gyur bcos/ sbyor ba rgyas pa'i 'gyur/mdzod kyi 'gyur bcos dang mchan/ rnam 'grel gyi 'gyur bcos dang mchan rnams mdzad cing / lha dbang blo'i le'u bzhi pa rtog ge'i skad rnams bsgyur ro/ /rgya gar du phebs skabs shig chos bdag bkra shis 'od 'bar dbu zhwa'i nang du zhugs nas 81

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /rjes su 'brangs te 'phrin las bsgrubs shing bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes par grags shing don la gnas sku / /skabs su sa skyar byon nas bla ma bzhi thog pa dang / bla ma 'jam skya la lam 'bras sku gas gsan/ de nas bla ma mchog ldan pa la yang mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan cing / bal por paṇḍi ta phal che bas tshur la man bsnyen dang dbo ngas rgyan mo gas zhus sku //de nas gung thang gnas sngo cher rdzo bo phyi dbon gyi zhu ba byas nas chodas gzhi 'dzugs par zhus nas bzhugs skabs shig bdag chen chos rin gyi sku tsha slob dpon a mo lha'i mi sna lho brgyud bdag por 'ja' sa tham ka skyel ba dang bsgrags nas rgya nag gong ma'i gdan 'dren byung yang / sa btsan pa mo gas kyis zhal gyi ma bzhes/ dgung lo so gnyis pa'i dus su dbyar chos la dus 'khor btsugs/dgun nas phar tshad dbu gsum rig gter rnams kyi dbu btsugs/ slob dpon bde blo mo gas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnga' ris pa phal gyis gsan no/ /bla ma dge 'dun bstan pa la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang dang lung mang du zhus zhing tshur yang chos zhus so/ /de nas bzung ste lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du bla ma mchog ldan pa la dbang bka' byin rlabs rigs gtad gang mo da zhu bar lan cig byon/ bla ma stag sde ba'i nang rten la mar me 'bul ba sogs la lan cig byon nas snar thang du phebs/ sa skyar tsa re tsam 'byon pa ma gtogs par gnas po cherabazhugs nas 'chad nyan dang rtsom bsgyur yang bsgyur mang du mdzad do/ /mngon pa dang tshad ma sa sde dang rgya 'grel gyis steng nas gsungs pas grwa pa rnams 'dzin 82

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/dka' bar byung nas ṭīkka mdzad par zhus pas/ de nas rtsom pa'i dbu tshugs so/ /tshar ba dang rang gi slob mas bskul te bgyis zhes gsungs so/ /ya rtse / 3la po'i gdan 'dren byung bas rang nyid kyis gong du bris nas gsung yig mdzad pas zlog go/ /paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa e'i mkhan dze mdzad mus nas rgyal mo rir bshad grwa btsugs na legs pa'i lung bstan slar yang gnang / sngar gyi 'gyur 'phro rnams dang / man snye/ 'jigs pa med pa'i gzhung 'grel/ dus 'khor 'phreng ba/ bde mchog mngon rtogs dang / 'e hi pa'i 'grel pa/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ na ro 'grel pa/ rdor snying 'grel pa/ mi gasku snang ba/ kā la pa'i 'grel pa rnams kyi 'gyur mdzad/ 'chad nyan gsal ba/ byang dzashāb kyi sems gsal ba/ dgongs rgyan gyi mchan dang sa bcad/ dbu ma rgyan gyi sa bcad/ mdo sde rgyan dang / bsdud pa'i mchan/ me long gi mchan dang sa bcad/ snying po gsal ba/ sdeb sbyor gyi mchan/ jo mo sgrol ma'i gse la 'debs/ gzhan yang bstod pa dang gamo la 'debs gnyis rnams mdzad/ skabs su dus 'khor sde ma 'byung / rtag gnyis/gsang 'dus/ dgongs rgyan/ dbu ma rgyan/ spyod 'jug /me long rnams gsungs so/ /bla ma ri 'dabs pa la sbyor drug dang dbu ma chen po/ ma gcig lab sgron ma'i gcod skor rnams khrid du zhus so/ /yang bar skabs su slar yang bdag chen a mo/ gha'i phrin yig mi sna dang bcas pa rgya nag gong gis gdan 'dren pas nyen nas/83

'grog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /a mo gha yis phrin yig sku da gyur kyang //ol tog 'tshod pa'i ngu ba la yang skrag/e ma da ni rnam rtog mabo gnan nas//u mu ka ltar gcig bur gnas par bya//zhes gsungs/ lan gnyis gsum du thar nas 'di skad lo//gangs can nag shong lo tsā ba/ /mang gul gnas chen khra smadar 'cha' dge sbyor gang 'phel gnas su sdod//yang na gzhan phan 'phel sar 'grims// zhes cung zad blo 'gyur bcad zhes gsungs shing / gdan 'dren gyi snga ga cha grol ba dang /sdig pa'i grogs po'i g.yo ba ring du spangs//bdud kyi zhags pa'i 'ching ba che las bo la//'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i gling du slebs//blo ༷ sa brtan pa'i bsam pa legs par 'grub//don dam nam mkha' lta bur spros dang bral ba la/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur bden pas stong par go/ mdo don sdig bshags byas pas bsngo ba dus su 'grub//dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa'i bsam pa legs par 'grub// 84

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/ces dang /shin tu sdig la 'dzem pa'i blos//mthos spyod bcu po 'bad pas grub//de yis gzhan phan ci nus byed//rnal 'dreger bdag gi las ka lags//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas sa skya bla brang du byon/ me long gi ṭīkka mdzad/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsdu/da nams rgyal mtshan gyis bkas ba3kyil nas/ dus 'kho ra gyi mchan bu dang / mngon pa'i ṭīkka gnyis pa mdzad/ e'i gdan sa'i 'dzin bdag 'a'o/da nas dbus phyogs su byon nas zla ba bcu drug bzhugs te/ dbus su byon pa'i lam du glegs bam mang po grwa pa la bkye ba rmis zhes gsungs shing lha sa dang bsam yas dang / gung thang / stag lung / byang rwa sgreng / gsang phya ne'u thog rnams su dus 'khor dang / dgongs rgyan dang / phar tshad dbu gsum/dbu ma rgyan/ sgra dang snyan ngag dang / zab mo'i mdo lnga sogs chos mang du gsungs shing / dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal cher gyis gsan te/ gsang phur chos grol ba dang / da ni shi yang mi 'gyod do zhes gsungs so/ /de nas yar gtsang phyogs su phebs nas snar thang du skor cig bzhugs nas/ mkhan chen klo bzang pas gtso mdzad pa rnams la dgongs rgyan dang / sgra dang snyan ngag sogs mang du gsungs nas/ bo dong e dang sa skya phyogs su byon nas snu sa mang du gsungs shing / bla ma kun spangs pas bskul nas sbyor drug rtsa 'grel gyi 85

'grog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'gyur mdzad cing yar lam shel dkar rgyal mo rir phebs nas dgon pa'i sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs par mdzad do/ bla ma ba ri ba gzi brjid seṅges bskul nas dus 'khor 'grel chen gyis bstod 'grel mdzad/ bla ma gzhon nu seṅges bskul nas tshogs gsum gsal bar mdzad/ gzhan yang rtsod rigs kyi 'grel bshad/ chodab 'phan gyi ci rigs pa/ 'grel pa brtag pa dang sgrub thabs 'ga'i 'gyur mdzad do/ /gnas gang dang gang du bzhugs kyang thugs dam gyi rim pa la chad med cing / steng 'grus med de bya ba la 'jug pa'i rim pa 'di ltar yin/ rnal 'byedar gyi bre kha khengs nas mnyam bzhag zab rnyed dang rnam rgyal gyis bzlas pa/ bzhengs nas galta ra ma'i rim pa/ bde mdzadag balha ma nas tsha ba gsol ja'i bar la bzlas pa/ de rjes 'chad rtsom bsgyur rnams mdzad/gdugs tshod la sngar bzhin bsgoms nas/ ja la rim pa rbedun gyi bar dmar nag /dmar spug /dmar seng / ser yar ldang gi bar la bzlas pa mdzad cing / thugs mnyes pa'i skabs su/sna sngon dus tsam na mkhas pa de//bcom ldan 'das shāka thub mi zer ram//sna( bar dus tsam na mkhas pa de//rgyan drug mchodag gnyis mi zer ram//cad da ltar tsam na mkhas pa de//dge bshes rgya gur mi zer ram /86

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/chab tsha yar gasku(la yar la gasdudal //zhes phyag rgya dang bcas nas ja gso/la bar mdzad do/ /dge bshes rgya gur ni dpang lo chen por ljags rgyan gur dkar phub pa lta bu yod pas/ bla ma rgya gur ba zhes brjod pas rang gis kyas zhal nas dge bshes rgya gur zhes gsu ngas pa grags so/ /de nas rtsom bsgyur dang bshad pa gang rung mdzad pa sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs dang gzungs sngags zab mo mang po bzlas brjod/ srod kyi cha la gtor ma'i rim pa dgu/ yi dam rnams kyi bzlas brjod/ sher snying sgrub pa rnams la nam gsum gnyis tsam lnga gas shing / de rnams bya ba 'jug pa'i go rim yin no zhes gsungs sku / /seng ser mchodag gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyis lnga ga drangs pa'i bla ma rnams la/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchodad nas dus mchodad la sku/gas pa'ang khrig ger 'dzin la/ bstan pa'i gce wa shākya thub pa'i dus mchodad kyang mdzad do/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku drin can rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud thob pa byin brlabs dang sku drin che/ lung bstan pa bzhin du bstan pa'i zhabs tog byed mi rnams kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab bzhin du lta ba ltar/ de dang mthun pa'i bya ba byed/ bo nga nas gong du je bzang je bzang la btang nas dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing sku na tan sgrub pa yin gsungs so// /de ltar dgung lo bdun nas drug cu cangabadun gyis bar du bstan pa'i bya ba lnga sa bsam sgom gsum/ ce ma bsgyur 'chad gsum gyis gdul bya'i don dang bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad gsungs te/87

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /bdag gis dang snga 'o/ bdun 'o/na pa nas// drug cu rtsa shas bar du shes bya la//slob lo bgyis kyang ci yang ma shes pa//zhes khengs skyungs kyang mdzad do/ /dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa chu pho rta'i lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi srod kyi dus su sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan cing / lo chen rang gi mtshan lam ltar bde ba can gyi zhing khams su dge ba'i bshes gnyen mo sa gus can 'ga'i gsungs nas dga' ldan du gshegs sku / /zhes gsungs pa gda' lags so//snga dus mkhan thog gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/bla med byang chub spyod la thugs bo mas pas//grangs med rgyal sras kun gyi yang rtse ru//legs gyur lnga rig padmo bzhad pa'i gnyen//lo chen bstan pa'i nyi mar gsol ba 'de bas//zhes pa'i bsngags brjod don ldan lo che na byang rtse ni/ zur rtso'i cha gog khro zhes par yab gzhon nu dpal bzang dang / yum dpang lo'i lcam mo ye shes sman nee la shing mo yos la 'khrungs/ bla ma mi bskyod pa spyan drangs te dbang zhus /mtshan chodas skyodang rtse mor btags/ de nas dgung 'o/ drug bdun bzhes pa na daXng lo chen po hor gyis gdan 'dren la gros nas/ bcad phu 'jigs med seṅge gling du mjal te dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa zhus/ mtshan byang chub rtse mo ra btags/88

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/de nas gshongs sku mched kyi dbon sngo mkhan chen snu sa skyong dpal la/ rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa ca nos/ de nas dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i lcags pho rta 'o(/ gung thang gnas 11 cher slob gnyer la phebs/ mngon pa tshad ma sku/gas thugs su chud de nas sa skyar byon/ malnga na pa kun btus la bskyar bshad mdzad pas ldan pa'i thad du sleb pa'i tshe mngon pa'i nang gi tshig don khams dang / sa gang du gang zag gang la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi chos/ sa bon dbang ldan mngon gyur du ldan pa'i tshul brtsi ba na/ bshes gnyen na bza' ngur smrig gsol ba'i yid du 'ong ba zhig yun ring por gsan cing 'dug /chos grol nas dpang 'o/rware spyan sngar khyodan pas lnga mkhyen nas/ da kyis chos gsungs pa de khyed yin nam gsungs/ yin lags zhus pas/ chos rang shin tu mkhas par gda'o gsungs/ de ni chos rje rgyal sras pa dpang 'o/ chen po bo dong e'i gnas la spyan 'dren par 'dug go/ /dgung 'o/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan wa don yod rgyal mtshan las byed dpal ldan blo bo sa brtan pa/ gsang ston chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ grib tshod pa dad pa'i dge 'dun sdom bstsa na dam pa la sogs pa bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de rjes dpang lo sku gshegs/ de nas chos rje rgyal sras pa bla ma dam pa bu ston pa rnams la gsang sngags 'gyur cog gi dbang lung man ngag rdzogs par thob/ de nas dka' chen bco brgyad kyi rim pa rnams la 'chad nyan stobs chen mdzad/ shangs/ rtse gdong / 'u yug /rong /nyang stod phyogs su dbang bskur chos bshad du ma mdzad/ lkugs pa dang gdon 89

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gyis gzir ba du ma la/ zhal mthodang bas phan pa dang / byin rlabs mdzad pa'i phan pa dang / ljags chab kyi phan pa mang du byung / mig nad pa mig nad las grol ba dang / cadan pa rna ba gsang du song ba/ rkang lag gi nad las myur du thar ba mo gas byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab bsnyu da kyis mi lang / phyi'i dngos po la 'dzin pa rtsa ba nas dor/ nang du bdag 'dzin spangs/ 'khrul 'khor cung zad re mdzad/ rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i gtsug tor mchog tu gsal por 'phags pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /skabs shig shel dkar du phebs nas bdag chen chos rin la dpang lo'i lung bstan bzhin bshad grwa tshugs shig pa'i bka' gnang zhing sa gzhi byin rlabs kyang mdzad do/ /chos lung byang rtser rgyang tsam bzhugs/gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod/ dbus su gong ma'i sne gdong du spyan drangs/ chodas dbang mang dze zhus/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan pa rnams rgyas par bkod/ dgung lo don bdun pa drag po'i rta pa zla ba'i nyer gcig la gtsang chu mig tu zhing brjes/ zhing khams sna tshogs su ༷ na pa'i malnga nga snang sna gro gas byung ngo / /rgyas par ni rje nyid kyi rnam thar las rtogs par bya'o//snga dus kyi mkhan thog gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rigs gsum lha'i//spyi gzugs mkhas grub dam par yongs grags pa'i//maro/ rgyud gzhung lugs dzadas kyi rgyal mtshan kun//'dzin mdzad mkhas btsun dbang por gsol ba 'debs//

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/zhes pa'i ba3 da yul ches mchodag tu gyur pa 'o/ chen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ la stod zur tsho'i sa cha bcad pu seṅge gling gi mdang phag chung zhes pa'i gnas su/ yab chodas skyodang bsam 'grub dang / yum dpal chen 'bum gnyis la/ chu 'o/ 'brug gi 'o/ gza' tshes bzang nyin sku 'khrungs/bla ma swā rje zla ba zhes pas rgyal mtshan rtse 31 zhes par mtshan gasdu/la/ gachoṭan nu'i dus ting nge 'dzin sgoms gsungs pa dang mnyam bzhag la 'jo ga /dben pa las dgyes/ skam chags chung / dul ba dang / byams snying rje che/ sbyin pa la dga' ba sogs byis pa'i khyodad pa ngan pa las 'das sku / /dgung lo bdun bzhes pa'i tshe/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo'i drung du/ dge bsnyen rab byung dge tshul legs par bsgrubs/ mtshan grags pa rgyal mtshan du btags/ de nas dpal e ru gyon/ lo du ma'i bar du dka' chen drug la so/gas pa bslabs te thos bsam mdzad/ paṇa chen rtse mo spyi bo'i jo nga bzhin bkur/ dgung 'o/ nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rgyal sras 'a〈sna ba'i mabosnan wa dang / paṇa chen byang chub rtse mo'i thog drangs dge slong mang po'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa nod/ khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la spang bya'i gtso bo mdzad/ nyes pa phra rags bshags sdodams yang yang mdzad/ rgyal sras rin po che la smon 'jug gi sems skyed/ bdag pas gzhan gces 'byongs pa'i byang chub sems la 'bad pa gal che gsungs/ de nas rgyal sras lnga gas med/ dpal ldan rtse mo / bla ma dam pa/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug dpal ba/ lo tsā ba bstan 'dzin bsod rgyal 9 /

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /11gas dus der/ grags pa'i bshes gnyen phal mo che'i zhabs la gtugs nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rabs dri ma med pa mtha' dag la gsan cing gzigs rtog bshad sbyong 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum 'bad rtsol cher mdzad/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dus mchodad zla mchodad/ tshes bcu gsum la dpang lo/ nyi shu la rgyal sras pa/ nyer gcig la byang rtse/ nyer lnga la bla ma dam pa rnams la mchod pa yang yang mdzad/ rtsa rnying bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi rnying ba brgyad rnams la bshags sde ma shin tu 'phel/ dgung 'o/ sum cu bzhes pa'i tshe dpal e'i chos grwar phebs/ rje 'o/ tsā ba chen po'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gso/la nas gdan sa pa mdzad/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ de dag gi dgongs 'grel bstod pa dang bcas pa'i bshad nyan/ sems skyed gdam ngag la mo gas pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i cos tshul du ma dang / snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ ming gi mngon brjod/tshig gi rgyan/ zlos gar la so/gas pa gang dang gang dodan du gnyer ba/ de dang de'i chos kyi dga' ston kha na ma tho ba med par bskyed de/ dge 'dun gyi sde chen wa dar bar mdzad/ dgung 'o/ sum cu so/ gcig pa la/ dgon pa gyam gyi gdan sar phebs/ chodas kyi 'khor 'o/ rgya chen sngo bskor/ de nas sa skya brang mo che'i gdan sar balha sa/ der theg chen gyi chos mang du gsungs/ de nas ta'i si tu chos kyi rin chen pa la sngar sor rje byang chub rtse mo'i bkas skul ba dang / 7lo chen grags pa rang gis shel dkar du chodas sde chen ngo 'dzugs par dgongs pa la/ si tu ba'i spyan drangs nas rje grags par mkhan rngorware zhu ba phul/ zhal gyis 92

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/bzhes nas dgung 'o/ sku bzhi bzhes pa'i shing mo glang gi dbyar chos la shel dkar gyi chos sde chen po btsugs/ dge 'dun byed brgyad brgya tsam la/ dka' chen so so la 'chad nyan mdzad/ ring por ma lon par phar tshad sbrel ba la sogs pa grwa skor ba thog re la yang bzhi bcu tsam byung / gzhan yang bka' bzhi bka' bcu mkhyen pa'i dge bshes brgya phrag du ma byung cad / /de nas mi ring bar shel dkar dbyar chos la mkhan khrod legs shing par grwa tshang bcu gnyis mkhan tshang pa/ gnas cosnog pa sku/gas bshad grwa mang du chosags par mtshan nyid kyi bshad nyan dang dgun chos la shel dkar sgrub mchod du grags pa mdzad mi dge 'dun rnams la dbang bskur ba dang / rgyud bshad pa dang / man ngag gi sbyin pa'i sgo nas skal ldan gyis gdul bya rgya mtsho'i smin grol du mdzad/ bstan pa'i sgron me chen po sbar/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa la/ khri rgyal bsod nams sde dang bka' bgros te/ shing pho khyi'i 'o/ gung thang chos sde btsugs/ mdo sngags kyi bshad nyan gyis gdul bya tshims par mdzad/ de nas bstan pa sku/ sku ra thog res kyis bshad nyan/ rang gi bla ma gong ma'i yi ge med pa'i dka' chen so sku la mngon rtogs rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i ṭīkka che chung gsum/ rnam 'grel gyi ṭīkka mngon pa kun btus kyi mdo tshig bsdus pa/ bsam gzugs kyi zur bskol/ mdzod kyi shiXkka/ dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag /'dul ba'i las snodagamado sde rgyan dang 'jug pa'i ṭīkka/ theg gsum gsal byed/ rtag gnyis kyi ṭīka la sogs pa mdzad cing / gzhan yang gdul bya mo so'i bsam pa dang mthun 93

'brog sde chen po rgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams la/bdag nyid kyis dngos su bzung ba tsam yin gyis/ bdag tu gzung ba med gsung zhing / gang la yang skad cig kyang chags par mi mnga'/ sa skya nas shel dkar du byon pa'i 'byung ngu lar jag pa byung ba bsnyugs pa thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs pa sogs lkog gyur gyis dngos po gang yang mi mkhyen pa med cing spyo 'bog dang nad kyis mnar ba 〈snags la byin gyis brlabs shing srung ba byas pa'am/ tha na zhal mthodang ba tsam gyis kyang sdug bsngal so/ sog las spyodal ba yin ce / /de nas skyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mos skal ldan rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ dben pa la thugs bzhol nas/ sa skya grang mo che'i bstan pa sprad/ e chodas sde'i bstan pa dang 'chad nyan gyi khur rje btsun la gnang / shel dkar snang bar dgongs pa la/ si tu bas bdag ma shi bar la gdan sa mdzad dgos zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul bas/ zhal gyis bzhes te bdag chen nyid la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i rdzogs rim zab mo gnang / de nas chu 'o/ rta 'o/ byang sems dkar po gyen du 'babs pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma dang bcas si tu gshegs/ 'khon kun dga' bkra shis pa'i thodag drangs/ lha skor gyi bla ma thams cad gshegs snyu gas la shel dkar du spyan drangs nas/ chos 'khor rgya chen po mdzad/ de'i tshe si tu ba'i sku che ba'i yodan tan/ snyan ngag gi rgyan dang ldan par gsungs mol gtam 'di tsam yang rang cag gis bskal par shes par dka' na/ zhes de nyid kyis bsngags pa kho na brjod do/ /zhe dgu ma grol gyi bar du cho ga mdzad cing phyis rten mchod 94

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/mang ba dang 'grel pa ro/na gsal gyi par gsar bzhengs tsha tsha mang ba 'debs pa gser 'bum gyis rab gnas sogs rgyas par mdzad nas chu 'o/ rta'i 'o// shel da//ra dang / mnga' ris kyi dgon pa'i bstan pa'i khur chen po rje btsun la gnang /de nas chu mo lug lo dge sdings su rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis chos khri'i drung du skye bo mang po la thugs skyed gcig gsung pa'i dus su/ me tog gi char 'babs/ 'bir ba pa dang dpal ldan tog rtse pa mngon sum du gzigs/ bla ma gong ma'i du sa mchodad kyis phyag mchod kyi skabs su zhal mngo na sum du gzigs/ rjes su rigs lnga'i rnam par gyur pas mchod yul gzigs pa yin no/ /de nas sman sding du lam 'bras dang blo sbyong la sogs pa'i khrid gnang dus/gegs byung ba rnams byin rlabs tsam gyis ༷ la bar mdzad de/ blos btang gi sgrub pa pho mo mang du byung / de nas gyam du rdor dbyings kyis dbang gnang ba'i tshe sa rnam pa drug tu g.yodas so/ /de nas khyung rtser dus 'khor gyi sku la rab gnas mdzad/ shel dkar du gdul bya'i blo dang mthun pa'i chos gsungs/ lo chen nyid shel dkar du bzhugs dus rje btsun red mda' pa yang shel dkar du bzhugs nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad do/ /rje nyid kyi 'dul ba'i las chog mdzad pa sdudags 'chad sgyu ma gsum gyi tha ma mdzad/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'od zer mjal bar 'dod pa la mtshams la 'dug pa'i bug sbedar phebs/phyis mjal bar zhus pa la ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i mi mjal ba'i bka' gnang /slob dpon bsod rin phyag phyir zhus pa dang / yar lam ldog gcod so gas 95

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /lam du mjal ba rnams la/ phyis mi mjal ba'i gsung 'a10sa gnang zhing / gzhan 'bru rtsam med pa'i g.yar res kyang slebs byung gsungs pa la so/gas pa ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i cha du ma gsungs/ de nas gram du byon nas shing mo bya'i lo gro zhun zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi dgong mo'i cha la/ kyi rdor gyi mngon rtogs lam dus dbang dang bcas pa rgyun galta ra nang mchodad/ mchod dbyangs/ maṇḍal/phyag mchod la sogs pa rdzogs par mdzad nas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas cho 'phrul mang du bstan nas/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams bce na 'grus la bskul ba'i phyir/ dgung 'o/ nga bzhi pa la mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan shed/ /de nas rje btsun gyi phyi rten nang rten la sku gas pa bdag nyid chen wa'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad do/ /rgyas pa ni 'jigs bral gyi mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam thar las rtogs par bya'o//snga dus kyi mkhan thog bzhi pa ni/ ji skad du/'chad rtsod rtsom la 'jigs med seṅge'i sgra //sgrog la zla bral kun mkhyen gnyis pa zhes//srid na grags pa ba dan ches dkar ba'i//gsang sbyin bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul mchog tu gyur pa rje btsun 'jigs bral chen lnga smra ba(sde zla ba dpal khyodags thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i 'o/ rgyus ni/bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du/ khra nga mo ba'i rigs zhig tu 'khrungs 96

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa stodabs kyi rgyal snga 'jig rten du byon pa la rang nyid btsongs pa'i rin balha sa su sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la phul nas/ dang po ri byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ bskal bzang las/de bzhin gshegs pa snang byed slong ba'i tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa stobs kyi rgyal 11 la//bshos dag rang nyid btsongs te sbyar nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni thugs bskyed do//zhes gsungs pa ltar de nas bzung ste bskal pa rgya masnu ra tshogs gnyis bsags zhing / bstan pa'i byi dor dang gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i tshul ni brjod par mi nus la/ thub bstan 'di la byi snga ra byas pa'i tshul masnga tsam brjod na/ nyan thos 'od srung chen snga/ra gyur te/ lha na pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i cadag tu/ bstan pa dge 'dun dang bcas pas bskyangs/ 'jigs bral zla ba grags pa 'khrungs te mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam gsal bar mdzad/ de nas rim gyis sgra sgyur bai ro gyur nas mdo rgyud du ma bsgyur zhing bod khams 'dir bstan pa'i sgron me chen po sbar/ slar yang mdo rgyud la 'khrul bar spyod pa dang skal ldan rjes su bzung ba'i phyir bo dong pa chen por sku skye ba bzhes pa'i gdung ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam snga re skye ba/ zhwa ma tsa ba seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / rje btsun sgrol ma lha gcig skadang jo'i sprul pa/ lcam ma gcig zhwa ma ye shes kyi ḍākki ma de la sras gcig byung ba de nas nye bar brgyud de dad ldan dge 97

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long 'dun rin chen zhes skyed rdzogs la bstan pa thob pa zhig byung / de sras sngags 'chang bamo da nams mgon po/ de sras snumis rgyal mgon/ de sras snu sa ldan/de la sras gsum byung ba'i sras bar pa ston pa chodas rgyal mtshan dang / 'o/ chen grags pa'i sring mo jo lcam byang chub chodas sgron gnyis kyi sras su dpa' bo mkha' 'bo rang bzhin gyi 'du ba'i gnas rgyal gyi shrī'i sngo gas dbyi gu zhes bya bar yos lo rdo na dus tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba dang mnyam du dge mtshan du ma dang bcas sku bltams ma thag zhal nas/ slo ltos thub pa ci yang med/ /gtad med spyon pa 'di 'dra snying re rje/ /zhes gsungs shing de nas dgung lo bdun phebs pa na gyam gyi ni sing na bzhugs dus mi dkar sngo/ mtshan rtags dang ldan pa gcig gi 'bras chan dang / pu sti khyer nas gyon te/ bu kho de zan 'di zo pu ti 'di khyod rang gi dgos skal yin gsungs nas tshar gcig bsgrags nas song ngo /de nas rje btsun grags pa'i drung du rab tu byung ba'i mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan du grags zhing rig gnas la sbyong bar mdzad pas snyan ngag mkhan chen por gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod brgya/ gzhon nu nor bzang dang / stag mo lus sbyin gyi rtogs brjod sogs mdzad/ gsung rab rnams la thugs spyong mdzad tshul bstan pa na mngon pa mdzod snga dro gcig la thugs su chud/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi shog bu lnga lnga lan gsum re bslabs pas nyi ma gcig la shin tu byang bar thugs su chud/ rnam 'grel dpang ṭīkka sogs dang phar phyin gralas ṭīkka sku gas la brten nas shel dkar du thugs gnyer rgya cher mdzad nas sa skyar 98

ngo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/dgung grangs dang mnyam pa'i pu ti la grwa skor mdzad/ 'kho ra ba'i ngang tshul la thugs skyod shas dpag med 'khrungs nas/ 'dri ga rten snang ba 'di la phar bltas pas//gang la bsams kyang yid 'byung skye ba'i rgyu//yid brtan blo ltos thub pa ci yang med//gtad med spyon pa 'di 'dra snying re rje// zhes yang yang gsungs so/ /de nas dpal shel dkar gyi chodas sde chen wa ra gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen grags pa'i mkhan po dang / mkhas rnga/ rkyen spro red mda' ba'i las slob rma riod nasomakhas rgub du ma'i ngabus/ su/ bsnyen rdzog/ri sa me dzad /de nas 'jam dbyangs dang ngabyangs can nga / pham ngalar la sogs pa lha du ma 'i bsnyen pa mdzad pas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs shing / khyad par du dbyangs can ma dang zhal 'bral med du gyur pas mtshan dbyangs can dga' ba zhes grags sku///ratna'i spyi'i lung du/ bee ro'i sprul pa bo dong pa zhes 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa ltar bai blorware sprul pa yin pas gsung rab kyi gnas gzigs pa tsam gyis mi 'ji gas pa'i spobs pa thob/ dgung 'o/ nyer gsum la bzhes pa'i tshe/ rtsed thang du phebs/ snyan pa'i ba dan gyis ba3/la te bshes gnyen thams cad kyis ngo mtshar ba'i bsu ba byas nas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ bsngags pa phun sum chogs bcadad do/ /de nas mkhas pa stong phrag du ma'i dbus su/ 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i khri la 'khod nas/ de dag gi blo dang mthun par pod chen 99

'brog sde chen po po rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /bco brgyad la bshad pa mdzad/ skal ldan gyi 'gro ba mang po rjes su bzung / gsang phur rigs dmar rgan po zil gyis mnan/ bshes gnyen stong phrag du ma'i dbus su dka' chen bcu gsum gyi grwa skor mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes su bzung ba kho naso// zhes zhabs spyi bor bslangs/ 'jig rten mig gyur blo gros brtan pa'i bu brgyud phun sum tshogs pa zhes bsngags pa brjod pa las bstsa na par gyur do// /de nas dpal e'i gdan sa chen 1rwasno bstan pa'i bdab/ por paṇa chen grags pas mnga' gsol mdzad/ 'o/ gsum gyi bar du mdo sngags kyi chos kyi 'aspo ba tshims par mdzad cing phar tshad kyi ṭīkka/ dka' 'grel/ rig gter kyi ṭīkka/sta nga bug rings/rig spos 4 /dzang/ ngo// /de nasag gad gas dang / spanga' ris 'a/ mo gas pa'i chos grwa rnams su si tu chos rin rnga/ nga/dzā / khri rgyal bsod nams lderobanesogs pas spyan drangs/ lo gcig la shel dkar du dka' bcu ba brgya tsam dang / dka' bzhi pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / shel dkar du mkhas pa chen po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang / mkhas pa 'u nga gi dbus su rtsod pa mdzad pas/ pha rol sngo/sa gdugs kyi phyag phul/ mi g.yo bas zhal gzigs/gzhan dag na re/ lha gcig ma ngo 'o/ga /spyodang gcig ma mgo ma thon/ zhes grags mo / /de bzhin du ngam rings su mkhas grub dge legs pa sogs dang rtsod pa mdzad cing pho brang bkra shis rtser bdag chen rnam rgyal grags bzang gis/ spyan drangs/ mkhas pa chen po rong lha na sogs rtsod pas pham par byas pas shin tu dad cing yi rangs bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang gshin rje gshed kyi dbang /00

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/sogs kyi tshe gshin rje dngos su mthong ba dang / bo dong du drug cu pa mdzad pa'i tshe nyid kyi dbu la 'jigs byed kyi rwa dang / zhal la de'i mche ba rab tu rtsig par mthong ba dang / smyung gnas mdzad pa na spyan ras gzigs su mthong ba dang / 'o/gas lo chos lung du bla ma legs pa bzang pos phyag chen sku/gas zhus pa na rje nyid kyi khri la mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dar dang rin po che'i spras pa gachodan nu'i cha lugs can bzhugs pa da1gas su mthong ba la mo gas pa/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya la gang la gang 'dul du gnang bas rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa'o/ /shel dkar du tu si chen po la dgun dus dbang bskur mdzad pas bum nang du ljang pa skyes pa la me tog mthing ka rdol ba dang / sa skya ri bo cher rje nyid bsnyun tshe gzim khang gi steng du byon nas gus pa'i tshul gyi mchod pa myur du lha ma gsungs nas/ rje ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la lha'i bdud rtsi gnang zhing rje nyid la 'phags pa byams pa la lha'i tshogs grangs med pa'i 'khor dang bcas pas snyun skor bar mdzad de dus de nyid du snyun dang ngo / /dge sdings su rnal 'byor dbang phyug la lam 'bras gsan pa la sku gas pa masngo na shes dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab cing / grangs pa las 'das pa sdusag sa rgyas par rnam thar gyi yi ge chen 31 rnams las shes par bya'o//snga dus kyi mkhan thog lnga pa ni/ ji skad du/'jam mgon ngag la dbang 'byor mkhyen brtse'i bdag/ mdo sngags chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i phyir//bshes gnyen bzang po'i gar gyis rnal rol pa//101

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long dpal ldan bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar snga so'i mkhan po khri thog lnga pa ru 'jigs bral chen po'i sring lcam lha mo mdzes ma la sras rje ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal ba'i dbang po/ gnyis 'khrungs pa'i che ba ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gdan sar phebs te/ rje 'di ni 'jigs bral chen po'i drung du sku chos mdzad de mtshan nyid theg pa'i gsan sbyong gsang phur mdzad cing sngags kyi rim pa rnams rje btsun la gsan no//mkhas pa'i dbang lnga shel dkar ba ngag dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos 1732 lor mdzad pa'i shel dkar chos 'byung legs bshad nor bu'i me long skal bzang mgrin rgyan zhes bya ba dbu can bris ma shog ldeb 53ba1 las/snga dus mkhan thog bcu gnyis ni/ ji skad du/nam yang mi g.yo khyod thugs mkha' dbyings ngos//med byung thugs rje'i 'od zer 'bum 'phyo bas//phan bde'i chu skyes 'dab stong rab bzhad pa'i//mkhas btsun nyin byed dbang por gamo la ba 'debs//zhes lo tsā ba shod bu dpal seng gi sku skyer grags pa'i rje nam mkha' 'od zer ni/ mi nyag ldong gi rigs las 'brog yar ba brgya dpon pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ gzhon nu nas sku chos mdzad de bye mkhar chos sde sogs grwa sa du mar mdo sngags la sbyangs pa mdzad pas mkhas grub tu gyur te/ rje nam mkha' rin chen gyi rjes su dpal shel dkar chos sde'i mkhan sngo mdzad/ rje gong ma rnams kyi mdzad srol /02

bo dong gi snga rabs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar thor bu re phyogs bsdebs/ma nyams par bskyangs/ dben gnas dbo na pa zhig 'debs par dbo ngas nas dgon pa sgam mchog gsar du btab ste/ der bzhugs nas thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad rtswa sa rtogs pa lhong du gyur nas thog babs pa sku chos su thum pas rje thog thub par grags pa sogs snga mtshar ba'i rnam thar du ma yod do//sngar dus mkhan thog bcu gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i blta ba dang //phyin drug spyod pa'i rin chen sna bdun dang //mngon par rab ldan rje btsun dam chos kyi//'khor los sgyur ba mchog der gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i bsngags brjod don ldan rje nam mkha' rin chen ma ni ldong rigs pa brgya dpon pa'i zhal ngor rgyal phu g.yu nyer du 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu nas chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa shas che bas dam pa'i chos sgor 'jug pa mdzad/ nyid kyi khya bo rje nam mkha' 'od zer gyis bkas boskul ba bzhin snye mo chos sde mo gas grwa sa mang dze ra mawa sngags kyi gzhung lugs rnams la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad pas mkhas par gyur te/ 'chad rtso da ce ma gsum la mkhyen dadre da rnam par yangs pas bka' ce ma yang 'ga' shas mchis/ skabs yig gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs te rje nam mkha' 'od zer gyi rgyal tshab tu shel dkar sogs dbo na gnas mang po'i chodas kyi khri la phebs/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas dar rgyas su 'gyur bar mdzad nas mkhan po gnang skabs mngon dga' chos sde gsar du /03

'grog sde chen po hro rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'debs par mdzad pa sogs phyag bris legs mdzad che tsam byung bar snang ngo //mkhas pa'i dbang po shel dkar ba ngag dbang skal ldan rgya mtshos 1732lor mdzad pa'i shel dkar chos 'byung legs bshad nor bu'i me long skal bzang mgrin rgyan zhes bya ba dbu can bris ma ༅ོga ldeb 34bzha las snga dus mkhan thog bco brgyad pa ni/ ji skad du/nam yang mi 'gyur thar pa'i go 'phang nyid//bgrod phyir mkha' lding nam 'phang spyod pa bzhin//rnam dkar mdzad pa bzang po'i sku bzhi'i sar//nyer bgrod bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs//zhes bsngags pa'i mkhan thog bco brgyad pa/ rje nam mkha' dkar po ni rje dathodan nam mkha' rnam sras kyi sras su rgyal phu nas phra'i lhas su sku 'khrungs/ mdo sngags la sbyangs pas mkhas grub tu gyur nas macadan dga' chos sde'i bla ma mdzad skabs/ chos 'kho ra lhun smra nas shel dkar gyi mkhan po 'byon mkhan ma byung bar brten/ bla ma rang gi dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur gang 'grub bcas chu rta lo'i shel dkar dgun chos rtags mtshon tsam zhig mdzad pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyams pa gso ba'i thugs 'dun mnga' ba'i mdzad pa yin pa sprod mtshar ba'i gnas mo / /'di yan la snga dus kyi mkhan lnga ga ces bakhyodad ro// /zhes gsal //04

༄༅/ /mnga' ri ba chos rgyal chen pos mdzad pa'i dga' ba'i gzhas zhes bya ba rtsed sna bcu gsum pa'i rim pa gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//na mo gu ru we/ bslab gsum rnam dag khrims kyi zhing sa la//brtan mkhas yon tan rdzogs pa dpal gyi gur//sgra dbyangs lha mos khyud pa'i mnga' ri ba /padma dbang rgyal zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes mchod par bakhyodad nas/ mnga' ri ba paṇḍi ta chen po padma dbang gi rgyal po zhes yongs su grags pa srid gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po bsgyur gnyis bstan pa'i srog shing de nyid kyi thabs mkhas thugs rje bla na med pa'i mdzad pa yongs su grags pa'i dga' ba'i glu gzhas zhes bya ba de la'ang sku na tan du ma dang ldan pa'i mdzad bzang de la/ dngas shel gtsang ma la byis dor byas pa bzhin/ rnam 'dren phyag na padmos thugs rje'i zla zer gangs can gyi ljo ngas su chos ldan rgyal po'i zol du bsam bzhin du dredan pa'i bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po bzhin mngal skyodan gyis ma bo sa pa yum gyi rtsibs 'o/gas g.yas nas 'bur te /05

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'khrungs pa'i gdung chen gangs ljongs kyi nor bu gdung drug gi ya gyal mchong ldong sbug sngo zhes sku ngas su grags pa sku'i 'khrungs yul khams spo phra rong nas yin zhes chodas rgyal chen lnga spo rong rje dbon zhes bya ba de nyid kyi mdzad pa che cher spel ba/ da lta'i bar du srol bzang ma nyams tsam du yin khul/ de yang dgos pa gang gi phyir/ tshul gang dang mthun/ mtshan nyid gang dang ldan zhe na/dathodas pa ni/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gis gtsos bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po rnams sku bltams pa dang / gser khrir mnga' ga sol ba/chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i phyir spyan 'dren pa/ gtsug lag khang sogs dkon mchodag gi rten sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / chodas rgyal chen sngo sogs sku'i gdung sras 'khrungs pa dang / rgyal srid dbang bskur ba mo gas/ phyogs bzhi'i bstan dgra btul ba'i dpa' rtags sku gas maro/ra na skal bzang dga' ston thams cad kyi mjug tu shis pa bcadad pa dang bcas/tshul gang dang mthun zhe na/ rdzogs ldan gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshul sogs dang /mtshan nyid gang dang ldan zhe na/ phyi ltar bu dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshul/ nang ltar du dam pa chos kyi tshig gi sgras yongs su khyab pa/ gsang ba ltar du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sems can la bde skyid sogs mdodar na dmigs yul rnams kyi mdzad 'phrin dbyar mtsho bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i smon pa dang bcas kyi sku na tan tshang dbo sa pa sku/gas rgan ngag gasnyadan chags kyi mthosgor tsam zhus pa/106

dga' ba'i gzhas zhes bya ba rtsed sna bcu gsum pa'i rim pa gsal ba'i me long /dga' ba'i hphu gzhas kyi rim pa dngos la/ thog mar gza' skar legs 'dzoms la/ snga dro'i char rnga bde lan gsum/ rnga brda dang por gzhas mi khrom spra so/gas zhal lag so/gas legs par mchod ces pa'i brda/ rnga brda gnyis par gzhas mi khrodam pa sogs rgyan gos sogs legs par spa da dbo sa pa'i brda/༄gsum par gzhas mi khrom pa sogs ma tshang med pa khra 'jig gor 'dzoms dbo sa pa dang / de nas gzhas bro la spyan drangs nas gzhas bro dang bzhes khrung bzhes nas/ ka bzhigadung brgyad pa blangs/ de nas sgo bshad lha mo phyi nang pa blangs/ yang yang gdung brgyan pa'i nang nas rgyal lu'i zhabs bcags sku gas blangs/de'i sked 'jog ga nas yin pa blangs/de nas pho gzhas nas ya gi gangs stodad mthon po'i lde mig g.yar po sogs blangs/ mo gzhas nas ya gi gangs stod mthodan wa ra sgyu nga gcig chags mo gas blangs/ de nas gzhas mi 'o/ mo nas mgul glu 'ga' shas bzhes/ de nas sgyu gzhas nas rtsed sna dang po gdong bsu ba blangs/ de'i sked 'jog la/ g.yas phyogs mda' dar dkar pos/ /dgra lha'i dbu 'phang gsos yod/ /g.yon phyogs mchod 'byu sngon mos/ /smon lam tshig gsum btab sku da/ /mo gas blangs/rtseod sna gnyis pa/ rma bya sogs blangs/ de'i sked 'jog tu rma bya log 'gra sags blangs/gsum pa/ 'a pha'i 'gying stabs rjes sked 'jo ga tu shar phyogs dpal gyi sogs blangs/ yang 〉sgo mo1 tshos glu 'ga' shas blangs/ 'o/ gzhas nas ya gi tsho 107

dga' ba'i gzhas zhes bya ba rtsed sna bcu gsum pa'i rim pa gsal ba'i me long /bcu gcig pa/ ja khang pa khyugs nas shel dkar padma blangs/ yang snga phyi la gzigs nas 'i( 'ga' shas blangs/ yang 'o/ gzhas nas/ gangs stod mthon sngo chags pa'i chags la rabs gcig sku/gas dang / mo gzhas nas/ dpyid gsum dpyid kyi dpyid zla dang po sogs dang / rmig yul la/ mjal dar su/shar rgya nas sprodan pa'i sku gas dang / bu 'khrid a ce'i mi bzhugs bu 'khrid a ce byon zer nas sogs dang / de'i sked 'jog tu/ lho sprin byang ma sogs dang /bcu gnyis pa/ sku ga sngo cha gcig mi bzhugs sdu/ga po cha gcig khyodan sogs dang / yang dku lagani ka blangarig/ wāopa/spyodaganas/ dngas sangs rngo nyal dngas sangs long sogs dang / mo gzhas nas/ phyogegs la shar gyi phyogs nas mchod rten bzhengs sogs blangs/ yang glu 'ga' shas blangs/bcu gsum pa/ gri bshad btang / dgra sha gcig /de nas gzhon pa 'a tsho'i bla ma'i gdan sa la byedan na/ bkra shis gdung dar so/gas dang / pho gzhas nas ri lu che ba dang / mo gzhas nas/ gangs stod malnga na po'i mthod shad nas sogs dang / yang glu 'ga' shas blangs dang / dgong mo 'o/ga /ra phywa gzhong dang blangs nas so so'i gzim chung du sprod skyid dang bcas bzhugs/gong du rtsed sna'i mtshams su khru 'ga' shas zer ba'i mgul glu rags bsdus tsam zhig zhus na/ ri lu brgya la shing nags lnga brgya yang mjal sogs dang / gser khri ser po sogs dang / gangs stod du bzhugs pa'i dngas sangs 'a tsho'i sogs dang / gangs stod mthon po mi 'gyur gdan la so/gas dang / chu 109

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /pa 'di nyid yin/ (snga mo'i bshad srol zhig la spo rong 'bur ba'i gdung rgyud chad mtshams bod la bkra mi shis pa'i dus shar sku nga zer bas/ 'bur ba'i gdung gi rje dbon mtha' ma ci rje dbon nam mkha' ngag dbang 'jigs med de nyid yin/rje dbon 'di phyi lo 1955 lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rjes shul 'dzin sras mo gsum las gdung sras ye nas ma bltams pas dus de nas bzung 'bur gdung gi rgyun chad pa yin/ 'o/ rgyus rgyas pa le tshan gzhan du gzigs thub ) gzhas chen 'di bzhin da lta'i bar du srol bzang ma nyams tsam yin khul yin/ 'di'i ngo bo yul gzhas phal ba dang mi 'dra bas/ 'di la dgos pa gang gi phyir/ tshul gang dang mthun/ mtshan nyid gang dang ldan/ sogs kyi khyad chos mang lnga 'dren rgyu yod pas/dgos pa gang gi phyir brjod na/ bstan 'dzin gyi skye bo dam pa sku bltams pa'am/ gser khrir mnga' gsol ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo balha ra ba'i phyir spyan 'dren pa/ gtsug lag khang sogs dkon mchog gi sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa/ chos kyi rgyal po sku gas kyi gdung sras 'khrungs pa/ rgyal srid dbang du bskur ba/ phyogs bzhi'i bstan dgra btul ba'i dga' stodan sogs/ mdor na skal bzang dga' ston thams cad kyi mjug tu shis par bsnyu da pa bcas kyi dgos pa las de min gang byung gang dran la 'khrab stodan byas na dbo sa pa las 'gal/tshul gang dang ldan zer na/ gzhas pa rnams rdzogs ldan gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshul//22

spo zodang gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/mtshan nyid gang dang ldan zer na/ gzhas pa rnams phyi ltar du dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshul dang / nang ltar du dam pa'i chos kyi sgras khyodags yongs su khyab/sasku/ nga ba ltar du gzhas chen 'di brgyud sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing sems can la bde skyid spe la ba sogs dmigs yul rnams kyi mdzad pa dbyar mtsho bzhin rgyas pa'i spyodan pa bcas kyi yon tan yod/rgyal gzhas 'khrab ston gyi rim pa bkod par/ thog mar gza' skar dge 'dzoms kyi dus blta/ de nyin snga dro'i char rnga brda lan gsum gtong ba yin/rnga brda dang por gzhas pa rnams dang rgya che khrom pa ra zhal lag legs par mchod dgos pa'i rnga brda yin/ rnga brda gnyis par rgyan gos 〈sna gas gzab masnu ra legs par mchod dbo sa pa'i rnga brda yin/ rnga brda gsum par gzhas pa dang rgya che khrom pa rnams ma tshang ba med par khra kyi le gzhas rar 'dzoms dgos pa'i rnga brda bcas so/ /rang re'i chos phyogs kyi zhabs rim la mgo skyabs sems nas mjug bsngo ba bar snga rjes kyi rim pa yod pa ltar gzhas chen 'di'i 'khrab don la'ang mgo sa btul nas mjug g.yang 'gugs bar snga rjes kyi rim pa gsal dze yod/rnga bde gsum pa'i rjes gzhas pa pho mo rnams star bang gcig tu bsgrigs te rgyal po'i pho brang gi rgyal sgo'i phyi rol du 'dzoms pa yin/ rgyal gzhas gzigs 'bul zhu bar mabo 'dzugs byed stangs gnyis su dbye bas/ gzigs 'bul zhu yul mabo na gyi gtso bo bzhugs gnas gzhan zhig nas wa rar gdan /23

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /'dren zhu dgos na phebs bsku'i gzhas ((ya shi'i gangs lha da malnga na po'i phyogs nas rtsa ba'i bla mas gathe byas lha 〈snags kyis bsu gzhas nas mgo tshugs/ de min sngar srol sgo rong rje dbon gyi pho brang gi mdun du pho brang gi bstod pa/ ((ka bzhi gdung brgyad gyi ces pa nas dbu 'dzugs kyis gzhas mabo gsham gsal le'u'i bang rim ltar yin/1 bkra shis pa'i gzhas/ ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ ces pa'i gzhas galta nga shin chas yong ba yin/ de nas sgyu brang gi rgyal sgo'i 'gram du 'byor 'phral/ 2 'o/ brang gi rgyal lha re bstod glu/ sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ zhes pa 'khrab kyin pho brang gi mdun du gzhas kyi do rar 'dzul/ de rjes sked 'jog ces/bar mtshams kyi gzhas sna/ ga nas yin pa gsung byung / zhes pa 'khrab/zha gzhas kyi sgo mo phye pa'i le'u/ ya gi'i gangs stod mthodan lnga sa/ lde mig g.yar rogs gnang dang / zhes yul de'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la gzhas kyi bang mdzod kyi lde mig g.yar rogs zhes gsol ba'i le'u dang /de'i zhabs bror/ g.yas la shigs shigs ma gnang / zhes pa 'khrab/ de rjes mo gzhas/ gangs stod ya ru snga nga gcig chags/ zhes pa 'khrab/ de'i zhabs bror/ lha la bu mo spun lnga yod/ de ring gzhas la spyan 'dren zhu/zhes pa 'khrab/4 mo gzhas/ spyan 'dren gyi gzhas/ gangs stodad ya ru/lda ja mchod phul ba'i le'u/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ steng du pho lha mnyes song /124

spo rong gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/mo gzhas su/ g.yas phyogs mdang dar dkar lnga / zhes pa 'khrab/snyo do ra sa btul gyi le'u/ do ra sa zhig mi zhu/ ro/ ra sa zhig zhu/ zhes yul lha gzhi bdag rnams nas gzhas chen 'khyab sa'i sa cha lha ra g.yar wa zhu zhes sa chog gi le'u/ de'i zhabs drodar/ shar gyi chu gas nas sgo gcig phye/ dang / de'i sked 'jog tu/ btang song zer na mda' gcig btang /zhes pa 'khrab/7 mjal dar phul ba'i le'u/ de'i zhabs bror/ e ma so/ bu 'khrid a ce ma bsdad/ dang / de'i sked 'jog tu/ lto sprin byang la thibs thibs/zhes pa 'khrab// de nas gzhas pa rnams kyi 'khrab chas kyi bstodad pa/ dodang rgyan pa/ dang /de'i sked 'jog tu/ gzhon pa'i g.yas la rgyus pa'i/ ba so'i sha krad dkar chung / zhes pa 'khrab/9 lha sa gnas mjal gyi gzhas/ dpal gyi chodas 'khor lha sa/ dang / de'i zhabs bror/ ma rdung mtshon cha rnam gsum yod/ ces pa 'khrab/10 me tog gi bstod pa/ rong gsum rong nas thon pa'i/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ me tog rkang pas ma len/11 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal la bstod pa/ e ma las ho/ dang /de'i zhabs snga/ra/ zhabs bro legs mo/ g.yas la shigs se gnang / g.yas dpa' bo brgya yi bsdo/gas sa yin/ zhes pa 'khrab/125

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /12 yul gyi bstodad pa/ ri bo brgya/ zhes pa 'khrab/13 de nas a ce rgya bza' bod du phebs bsu'i gzhas/ zla ba dang gro'i tshes pa bco lnga dang / de'i zhabs bror/ thang de e ma thang la zhed mi dgos/ zhes pa 'khrab/14 snod bcud kyi bsde da pa/ gangs stod ya ru su bzhugs su ma bzhugs /15 rgyal 11re chibs ra'i bstod glu/ sa gzhi padma/ de'i zhabs bror/ gcigaganyis/ gsum/ a ma'i bu mo na sdu/ gzhon ma/16 nam dus dbyar kha'i bstod glu/ zla la dbyar zla/ de'i zhabs bror/ rten 'brel yina'ang 'grigs sdudang /17 snod bcud kyi bstod pa/ gangs stod kyi mthon sngo /18 ja dang ja khang gi bstod pa/ ja khang nga / de'i sked 'jog tu/ shel dkar padma'i ri la/19 ༷/la gzhas/ a ma'i bu mo/ zhes pa /20 gzhas pa rnams kyi 'khrab chas kyi bstod pa/ khyug khyug la btang 'gro/21 ras pa'i gzhas/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ gser zangs zam pa'i steng nas/22 gu sa btud kyi gzhas/ phyag gsum pa/ de'i sked 'jog /dpon po bzang po'i 'og re/ (le'u 'dis mgron gyi gtso bo'i gtsos sku mgron rnams dang rgya che khrom pa ba rnams nas gnang sbyin gnang bar thugs rje che zhu'i zhwa 'bud dang bcas gus btud mchosan pa yin )23 bla ma'i gdan sa'i bstod pa/ rtsed sna kho cag pa/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ pho 126

spo moring ga'as chen rgyal gzhas/brang dmar po'i grib bsil/ 24 rtsod sna rma bya'i gzhas/ rma bya/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ rma bya log 'gro log 'gro/26 rang byung ri dgas sems can gyi skad gdangs kyi rtsed sna/ gsung gdangs 'di la/ de'i sked 'jog tu/ sha ba rang la skyes pa'i/26 sngo gzhas/ gri yi rgyal snga dpa' dam rgod po khra gsum gyi bshad pa dang gri rtsed/ gri bshad/ 27 gzhas chen 'di'i mjug bsdams le'u g.yang 'gugs kyi gzhas/ phywa shong nga / rgyal gzhas 'khrab tshan sku/ sdurware gzhas tshig bkod par/ phebs bsu'i gzhas glu / ya gi'i gangs stod malnga na po'i khyedags nas/rtsa ba'i bla mas gtsos byas grwa btsun 'dzoms lnga gcig phebs byung /gangs seng nga yang mi sdod/ gangs seng g.yu ral ngom bzhin bsu ba la 'gro/ g.yu ral legs mo lnga ma bzhin bsu ba la 'gro/ya gi'i rdza stod mthon warware phyogs nas/mgo 'dren dpon pos spru/ce sa byas chab 'bangs 'dzoms po gcig phebs byung /'brong chung nga yang mi sdod/ 'brong chung rwa rtse ngom bzhin bsu ba la 'gro/rwa rtse legs mo ngom bzhin bsu ba la 'gro/127

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /ya gi'i brag stod mthon po'i phyogs nas/drin can pha mas gtsos byas bu phrug 'dzoms po gcig phebs byung /bya rgyal nga yang mi sdod/ bya rgyal gshog sgro ngom bzhin bsu ba la 'gro /gcadag sgro legs mo ngom bzhin bsu ba la 'gro/1 ka bzhi gdung brgyad/ka bzhi gdung brgyad kyi nang na/ /rgyal po'i zhabs khyodan bzhengs yod/zhabs gyodan 'ja' ma bzhengs yod/ /de 'dra bdag la mi dgos/rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul yod/ /phyi ma yar 'dren la phul yod/ka bzhi gdung brgyad kyi nang na/ /rgyal po'i zhabs zon bzhengs sku da/zhabs khrodan rgya tshos kyis bzhengs yod/ /de 'dra bdag la mi dgos/mgo 'dren dawa na po la phul yod/ khams gsum dbang 'dus la phul yod/ka bzhi gdung brgyad kyi nang na/ /rgyal po'i zhabs sgro gas bzhengs yod/zhabs sgrogs sngo khra gcig bzhengs sku da/ /de 'dra bdag la mi dgo sa/drin can pha ma la phul yod/ /bsod bde'i rgyab rten la phul yod/sked 'jog glu/ /ga nas yin pa gsung byung /ga nas yin pa gsung byung / so ya la so// gsal gsal bshad dbo sa mi 'dugañdza/ga khra la shig /gsal gsal bshad dbo sa byung na/ so ya la so/gling rgyan gzhung nas yin no/ /spug khra la shig/28

shā spo 1—nga gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/2 sgo bshad kyi le'u/ sgo mo phye/sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/ya// them ser po'i gser la byas yod/sgo mosna phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/mas them kham pa'i dngul la byas sku da/sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/sked pa dkar po'i dung la byas yodad/sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/ru bzhi sbug po'i mchong la byas yod/sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/sne lcags lu gu brgyud la byas mo da/sgo mo phye/ nang la phebs/ phye nang la phebs/zha gzhas kyi sgo mo phye glu/ sde mig g.yar po gnang dang /ya shi'i gangs stod mthon lnga nas/ /lde mig g.yar dze zhu rgyu yin/lde mig gajigar po zhus zin na/ /gzhas kyi sgo mokho phye rgyu yin/gzhas kyi sbed mo phye zin na/ / gzhas dadze na mang la hrag pa yod/gzhas dopon mang la hrag pa yis/ /glu gzhas rkang bro gtong rgyu yin/zhabs bra/129

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dngas gsal me long /g.yas la shig shig ma gnang / /g.yas phyogs dpa' phrarware bzhugs sa yin/gasku na la shig shig ma gnang / /gasku na tshudags dpa' mo'i bzhugs sa yin/phyi la shig shig ma gnang / /rgya che kho ma pa'i bzhugs sa yin/ nang la rug rug ma gnang / /gzhas dasngo na a jo'i bzhugs sa yin/g.yas shig g.yon shig ma gnang / dpa' dang dpa' morware bzhugs sa yin/4 spyan 'dren gyi gzhas/ gangs stod ya ru sgyu nga gcig chags/snang gzhas/gongs stod ya ru rdzong gocigo chags/ /rdzong bdag gangs seng dkar mos byas/rdzang bdag g.yu ral sngan mas byas/rdza stod ya ru rdzong gcig chags/ /rdzong bdag 'brong chung rwa sngon byas/ /rdzong bdag rwa rtse legs mos byas/brag stod ya ru rdzong gcig chags/ /rdzong bdag bya rgyal rgod pos byas/ rdzong bdag gasna ga sgro legs snga sa byas/spang stod ya ru rdzong gcig chags/ rdzong bdag sha ba rwa bcus byas/ rdzong bdag rwa bcu legs sngo sa byas/zhabs snga// tshu lha la bu mo thun lnga yod/ /de ring gzhas la spyan 'dren zhu/ (nyis len )klu la bu mo spun lnga yod/ /de ring gzhas la spyan 'dren zhu/ (nyis len )/30

spo blosang gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/btsan la bu mo spun lnga yod/ /de ring gzhas la spyan 'dren zhu/ (nyis len )lnga gsum sdom pa'i bco lnga yod/ /de ring gzhas la spyan 'dren zhu/ (nyis len )ngaga' ba'io phyogs la log nas 'gro/ /skyid pa'i phyogs la log nas 'gro/lda ja mchad/steng phyogs lha la gnas pa'i / lha rgyal dbang wa brgya sbyin khong la/ suo ya la mchodad/mchood la/ mchodad/ mchodad pa 'bul/ a khu ja bas/ a khu ja bas/ swo ya la mchad /mchod la/ mchod/ mchod pa 'bul/bar phyogaso btsan na gnas pa'i/ btsan rgyal g.yu dmar rgyal chen khong la/ swo ya la mchad/mchod la/ mchodad/ mchod pa 'bul/ a khu ja bas/ a khu bya bas/ suo ya la malcaged/'ogo phyogs klu la gnas pa'i/ klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen khong la/ suo ya la mchad/mchod la/ mchodad/ mchodad pa 'bul/ a khu ja bas/ a khu bya bas/ suo ya la mchod/sred 'ardoog gzhas/3/

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /pho gzhas/ steng du pho lha mnyes song / dgra lha'i dbang po mnyes song / 'og tu klu mo mnyes song / dung skyong dkar mo mnyes song /mo gzhas/ g.yas phyogs mda' dar dkar pos/ dgra lha'i dbu 'phang gsol yod/ g.yon phyogs mchod 'byu sngon mos/ smon lam tshig gsum rgyas yod/ca sa yi mchod pa/ sa btul gyi le'u/do ra sa zhig mi zhu/ dod ra sa zhig zhu/ steng phyogs lha yi yul nas do ra sa zhig zhu/ lha rgyal dbang khrod brgya sbyin/ dod ra sa zhig zhu/do ra sa zhig mi zhu/ dod ra sa zhig zhu/ bar phyo gas btsan gyi yul nas/ do ra sa zhig zhu/ btsan rgyal g.yu dmar rgyal chen la/ do ra sa zhig zhu/do ra sa zhig mi zhu/ do ra sa zhig zhu/ 'og phyogs klu yi thul nas/ do ra sa zhig zhu/ klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen la/ do ra sa zhig zhu/zhabs bra/shar gyi phyogs nas sgo zhig phye/ oṃ su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ dro 'jam nyi ma'i sgo zhig phye/ 81 su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ gling bzhi dros pa'i sgo zhig phye/ 'dzi su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/lho yi phyogs nas sgo zhig phye/ tsosna su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ shing chen stag pa'i na zhig phye/ oṃ su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ stag pa sdong po'i sa zhig phye/ oṃ su ma ṇḍi padme hūm̐/132

spo rong gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/nub kyi phyogs nas lha zhig phye/ skyes swa ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ chu chen kham pa'i sbo zhig phye/ oṃ swa ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ chu sna 'dzoms pa'i sgo zhig phye/ tsosna swa ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ khang gi phyogs nas sgo zhig phye/ oṃ su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ shel tsha dkar mo'i sgo zhig phye/ oṃ su ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ bro mchog ldan pa'i lha zhig phye/ oṃ swa ma ṇi ji dme hūm̐/sked 'jog /btang song zer na btang song /btang so/nga zer na mda' gcig /bkug mo nga zer na gzhu gcig /nyag phran mda' mo'i gtong tshod/ ba so'i sha krad dkar chung /7 mjal dar/shar rgya nas thon pa'i/ sman tse la yi ser wa /rtsa ba'i bla ma mjal ba'i / mjal dar nyan pa yod/phyi ma yar 'dren mjal ba'i/ mjal dar nyan pa sku da/shar rgya nas thon pa'i/ a shes la yi dkar sngo /mgo 'dren dpon wa mjal ba'i/ mjal dar nyan pa sku/da/khams gsum dbang 'dus mjal ba'i/ mjal dar nyan pa yod/shar rgya nas lnga na pa'i/ bkra shis la yi kha dar/drin can pha ma mjal ba'i/ mjal dar nyan pa sku da/ bsod bde'i rgyab rten mjal ba'i/ mjal dar nyan pa sku/da//33

'brog sde chen po po rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /zhabs 11/e ma swo/ bu 'khrid a ce ma bsdad/ bu 'khrid a ce phyin pas/e ma se / bu 'khrid a ce phyin pas/e ma suo/ bdag la chodas 'khor lha sa'i/ lam kha ston rogs gnang dang /e ma se / lam kha ston rogs gnang dang /e ma swo/ sgo mo gser sgo g.yu sgo/ phye zhing phye zhing phyin pas/e ma suo/ phye zhing phye zhing phyin pas/ e ma lha / skras pa gser skras g.yu skras/ 'dzegs shing 'dzegs shing phyin pas/e ma swo/ 'dzegs shing 'dzegs shing phyin pas/e ma suo/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ gser khri'i steng du mjal byung /e ma swo/ gser khri'i steng du mjal byung / e ma swo/ yar la mjal dar phul bas/ mar la tshe mdud gnang byung /e ma swo/ mar la mjal dar gnang byung /e ma suo/ tshe lo lnga brgya thub pa'i/ tshe dbang tshe mdud gnang byung /e ma se / tshe dbang tshe mdud gnang byung /sked 'jog /lho sprin byang la thibs thibs/ lho sprin byang la thibs thibs/ byang sprin lha la thibs thibs/sbra chen gling khyim dar cog /'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs song /134
