sgyutho snangang gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/24 rtsod sna rma bya/rma byā rgya gar shar la gyon zer na/sgrosamadongs bum pa zhog /bum pa'i kha brgyan la dgos/bkra shis glu gar la phebs/sog po sog yul la byon zer na/sog byil gzho na pa la zhog /gzhon pa'i spam bzo la dgos/bkra shis glu gar la phebs/kong po kong yul la byon zer na/kong zhwa gasnya dan pa la zhog /galo na pa'i spam bzo la dgos/ bkra shis glu gar la phebs/sked 'jog rma bya log 'gro 'o/ga 'gro/ /rgya gar shar la log 'gro /yang la zer na zhus pas/ /rgya gar shar la log 'bo /bkra shis sgrol ma lags/ rgya gar shar la log 'gro/ /yang bskyar sgrol ma lags / rma bya skyes pa'i skyes yul/ /rgya gar shar nas yin no/yang la zer na zhus pas/ /rgya gar shar nas yin cerdzo/bkra shis sgrol ma lags/rgya gar shar nas yin no/ /yang bskyar sgrol ma lags/155

'brog sde chen po skyo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me myong /25 rtsed sna gsung gdangs nga /gsung gdangs 'di la rgod po'i gshog sgro zhig zhu/yin la/ gshog sgro legs mo zhig zhu/ yin la/ bkra shis pa'i glu gar la phebs/gsung gdangs 'di la seng ge'i 'gying tshul zhig zhu/yin la/ 'gying tshul legs mo zhig zhu/ yin la/ bkra shis pa'i glu gar la phebs/gsung gdangs 'di la nya mo'i 'khyug 'gro sa shig zhu/yin la/ 'khyug 'a11sa legs 31 zhig zhu/yin la/ bkra shis hphu gar la phebs/gsung gdangs 'di la sha ba'i pus btsugs la zhu/pus btsugs legs mo zhig zhu/yin la/ bkra shis glu gar la phebs/sked 'jogasha ba rang la skyes pa'i/ /sha phrug rang lta ma yin//a kyang sha ba'i pus btsugs/ /e shes mi shes bltas dzarshag/26 dpa' brtul gyi gri rtsed/ gri bshad/ (1)'o na la swo/ sngon mo'i gri la gri bshad cig yod dang med//56

sgo rong gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/gzhon pa hrū/ bshad rgyu yod na shod dang / bshad rgyu med na bshad pas chog /nyon cig ang /'o na la swo/ sdon mo'i gri la gri bshad cig los kyang yod/mkhas pa tsho/ bshad pas chog /nyon cig ang /'o na la sred/ dpa' dam cha la ga 'dra zhu/ ci 'dra zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la suo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ dpa' dam cha la mgon po khra gsum zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ gri shubs cha la ga 'dra zhu/ ci 'dra zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ gri shubs cha la seng ldeng kha sbyor zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ gri lung cha la ga 'dra zhu/ ci 'dra zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la swo/ gri lung cha la stong skud gsum sgril zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ gri zhags cha la ga 'dra zhu/ ci 'dra zhig zhu ba yin cad// e ma la swo/ snying gi songs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ gri zhags cha la 'o/ legs ljang pa zhig zhu ba yin no///57

'grog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /e ma la lha / snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ dpa' lung cha la ga 'dra zhu/ ci 'dra zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra yod btul rgyu yin/'o na la suo/ dpa' lung cha la dar tshon sne lnga zhig zhu ba yin no//e ma la swo/ snying gi sangs sangs la/ snying la sangs ba'i dgra bo btul rgyu yin/gri bshad/ (2)zer gcig ya la khra ma sku/da/rgyal 11 khri la bzhugs pa 'dra/zer gnyis ya la khra ma sku da/rgyal chothon bka' gros cho gas pa 'dra/ zer gsum ya la khra ma yodad/ bu spun gsum 'tsho thabs bsko ra ba 'dra/zer bzhi ya la khra ma yod/khang dkar po gru bzhi bslangs pa 'dra/mabo/ bo ya la khra ma yod/ri bo gangs kyis phub pa 'dra/dpa' dam sked la khra ma yod/rgod wa sa 'dab ma bsnan pa 'dra//58

spo modang gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/yas 'khor ya la khra ma sku1da/pha ldi ma'i sgom thag bskor ba 'dra/mus 'kho ra ya la khra ma sku da/dman bu mo'i khyim so/ zin pa 'dra/gri 'di nas mtho gang ston zer na/rno med ngar med mtho gang yod/gri 'di nas mthod gang ston zer na/ lto chen ngar chen mtho gang yod/gri 'di nas mtho gang ston zer na/sha chod rus chod mtho gang yod/gri 'di nas masprod gang ston zer na /sha za khrag 'thung mtho gang sku da/gri zang nger ston na 'bar ba yin/ gazlothon pa'i ab bsod 'bar ba yin/gri 'phred la g.yugs na gcod pa yin/sdang dgra bo'i sked pa gcod pa yin/gri sa la btsugs na rdib pa yin/sdang dgra bo 'i snying rtsa rdib pa yin/gri 'di dang gzhan gnyis 'dra sa med//59

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /steng lha yi mgar ra dar po dang /bar btsan gyi mgar ra dar po dang /'og klu yi mgar ra dar po bcas/dar po gsum gyis dar brdungs bkugangar rgyag rgya mche'ire mthil la byas/ngar tsha do lnga brgya la byas/ngar chu bshan pa'i khrag la byas/ngar ma yag po de nas byung /gri bshad/ (3)mabo 'dren dawa na po'i gnang ba'i/dpa' dam mgon lnga khra gsum/phyi yi dgra bo btul dus/dgos pa chen po byung /rtsa ba'i bla mas gnang ba'i/chos la dam chos pu ti/phyi ma bar do bshags dus/dgos pa chen po byung /yab chen a phas gnang ba'i/ 160

spo gro nga gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/ba so'i sha krad dkar chung /nyag 9phran mda' mo galta nga dus/ datre sa pa chen ngo byung / ༷/ma chen a mas gnang ba'i/gos chen ser po'i phor shubs/nang gi gnyen 'khor skyodang dus/dgos pa chen wa byung /jo jo ming pos gnang ba'i/rgya gri skar ma smin drugapho gzhon mang po 'dzoms dus/dgos pa chen po byung /tshe grogs bzang pos gnang ba'i/sor gdub dam pa 'bur bsgril/mo gachodan mang wa 'dzoms dus/dgos pa chen wa byung /de nas gzhas dpon gyis 'gying dang a mas bskul 'thodad bcas dgra sha legs par bcag zin pa dang dgra sha chag po gri rtser khyer nas rgyal kha'i rnam 'gyur mtshon ched skad sgra chen pos glu 'di ltar len no//6/

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /gri bshad/ (4) ma rdzo'o re'i a pha rgad pos btang la songo /dgra sha lag pa g.yas pa bcag la sang /'o re'i gcig dang lung pa'i phu ya nas/gangs ri dkar po maṇḍal phul ba 'dra/gangs ri dkar wa maṇḍal phul ba min/rtsa ba'i bla mas dbu zhwa bsnams pa 'dra/'o re'i gcig dang lung pa'i byang phyogs na/rdza ri dmar po maṇḍal phul ba 'dra/rdza ri dmar po maṇḍal phul ba min/grwa btsun 'dzoms ngo chodas ra tshogs pa 'dra/'o re'i gcig dang lung pa'i shar phyogs na/g.ya' ri sngon po 'khor gsum bskor ba 'dra/g.yang ri sngo na po 'khor gsum bskor ba min/galo na pa cad rang sgyu bo sa khyodan pa 'dra/'o re'i gcig dang lung pa'i lto phyogs na/spang ri ser po nyi ma shar ba 'dra/spang ri ser po nyi ma shar ba min/pha ma bzang sngo bu phrug 'jo mas pa 'dra//62

lhu blodang gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/gri bshad/ (5 )gzhon nga/ tsho/ bla ma'i gdan sa red/ yin la bkra shis mjal dar shigs/shigs shigs par gnang dang la/gzhon pa tsho/ dpon po'i gdan sa red/ yin la bkra shis mjal dar shigs/shigs shigs par gnang dang la/gzhon pa chos/ pha ma'i gdan sa red/ yin la bkra shis pa'i mjal dar shigs/shigs shigs la gnang dang la/de nas gri rtser mar khyer te bkra shis legs par gsol rjes gzhas pa rnams chabs cig tu phyag rgya dang bcas dpa' dam gri shubs nang du bcug dgos/27 sdo g.yang gi gzhas/ phywa 'gugs/ g.yang 'gugs/phywa shor pa ni phyin pa med/ g.yang shor pa ni nyams pa med/phywa khug shog /g.yang khug shog yul la dga' ba'i nyi ma shar/ nyi ma 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar/phywa khug shog /g.yang khug shogayul la skyid pa'i zla ba shar/tshes chen bco lnga'i zla ba sharo/phywa khug shag /g.yang khug shag

'brog sde chen po sgo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i zhabs bro la phebs/zhabs bro gsum rgyag legs mo la phebs/phywa khug shag /g.yang khug shag/ces gzhas chen le'u rdzogs so// sarba maṅga lam̐//28 rgyal gzhas kyi 'khrab chas/'o/ chas/dbu la dbu zhwa ser zing /rna g.yas gaX/ yi sdudag byil/mgul la gzi yi zhags pa/zhal ras yan gyi rgyan no/lus la ga'u sbrags dbang /gasku/na nas g.yas su gyon no/ba so'i sha krad dkar chung / mthe bo g.yas kyi rgyan yin/nang du stod thung dkar po/de'i steng ras kyi gos sngon/de'i steng stod duo ser thung /zhabs la zhabs zan ༷/ lham//64

spo rong gzhas chen rgyal gzhas/mdun du pang khebs khra ma/de'i steng ser ril smyug sgrogs/g.yas su rgya gri mda' dong /g.yon du dpa' dam gri zhags/ de'i 'og gos kyi phor shubs/phyag g.yas rta yi spa lcagagazhon pa 'o re'i rgyan byed/31 chas/dbu la spa phrug ma 'o//de mnyam ltag rdzar spa lung /rna ba gzi gaX/sa rgyan no/ mgul la ga'u ag btags/zhal ras yan gyi rgyan yin/nang du stod thung tshos ma/de'i steng phyu ba phu med/de'i steng mdun du pang gdan/de'i steng rgyab tu sked gdan/mdun du dngul gyi sked sdigasked gdan skor ba'i sne bsnon//65

'brog sde chen po slo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /phyi gos steng brtsegs 'ja' ma/zhabs la zhabs 1sten 'ja' ma/sku rgyab dar gyis gasku/gas sku/da/ phyag g.yas ce)sa dung dkar sngo sa/ngom zhing mda' dar 'phyar ro/gzhon ma 'o re'i rgyan no/

la stod yul gzhas kyi gle nga brjod/la skad khul gyi yul mi rnams yul phyo gas so/ so/ra yul gzhas la shin tu dar mo che bas yul khug lha nga sde chung ngu zhig las med kyang khul der yul gzhas la mkhas pa'i gzhas dawa na 'o/ mo re zung med du mi srid pa red/ yul phyogs so so'i chos srid rten 'brel gyi dga' ston skabs dang / de bzhin deng dus kyi mtshan tshogs ltar dpyid nyi ring po'i dus su yul mi phal che ba dgong dro nyi yol tsam nas mtshan gyi nam smad bar grong sde'i thang dkyil du me gor spar te yul gzhas 'khrab sre dal sku da red/ de dus na gachodan pho mo rnams bung ba me tog la 'khor ba ltar tshang tshang rub rub 'dzoms shi nga phan tshun dbar brtse dung gi rnam 'gyur la ro/la ba'i dus shi ga kyang red/nged rang chung dus dran par/ nged kyi khang pa'i ma dun thang der sbra chen yul mi nas yul gzhas 'khrab sku la sku da/ thengs gcig 'jigs med chos rgyal zhes pa'i pho gsar zhig gis bu'i gzhas gral nas thon te bu morware gzhas gral du zhugs pa dang kho rang gi blo la yod pa'i bu mo de'i lag pa dam por 'jus nas zhabs sprad 'khyab kyin bu mo der skabs re sen 'thog brgyab pa dang / skabs re zhabs bro'i rkang gra nor khul gyis bu mo'i sgang la ril grabs byed pa sogs brtse dung mtshon pa'i bsnya/da 'chodal sna tshogs spel/ bu mo de'i ngos nas kyang ngo tsha smin mdog gi mgo bo sgur tsam byed pa las don du bu'i lag pa dam por 'jus te /67

'brog sde chen po spo rong gi byung ba brjod pa dwangs gsal me long /mtshan gang yul gzhas la rol pa dran gyi 'dug /'di'i skor spo rong pa rgan gras la dris pas/ 'di las khyad mtshar ba'i rnam 'gyur gzhan zhig yod pa ni skabs re bu'i phreng mdzub (ma ṇi grangs gsog la phreng ba bgrang byed kyi mdzub mor brten yul skad du phreng mdzub grags ) bu mo'i mchu to la reg srol yod 'dug pas de ni deng sang gi 'o bskyal ba'am mchu reg pa'i tshul de red 'dugabyed tshul 'di la rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig kyang 'dren rgyu 'dug pa ni/ skabs re rigs rus phran tsam mi mthun pa'i pho mo gnyis dbar brtse dung byung na rigs rus mtho ba de yis zhan pa de'i mchu la reg ste/ rus pa mnyam bsres sam/phal skad du kha bsres pa yin zer nas rigs rus mtho ba de'i rang ngos nas rigs la snang ba byed kyi med pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig kyang red 'dug /yongs grags kha rgyun la/ sems pa sna/ra na sna ra sku/nga brjod/ /sen 'thog brgyab nas tsha rogs red/ /ces pa'i kha rgyun de'i 'byung khungs de 'dra red 'dugayul gzhas ni snga da kyi yul phyogs so skurware thun mo nga ma yin pa'i chags ji rabs dang snyedad bcud kyi bkod pa/ goms gshis dang lam srol sogs legs par mchodan zhing mi rabs nas mi rabs bar du rgyun 'dzin bgyis pa'i rig gzhung rtsa che zhig red/ yul gzhas dang yul glu la dbye na gnyis te grong tsho chung ngu zhig las med kyang yul de'i yul mi tshos rang bzhin gyis brtsams pa'i yul gzhas gcig dang / yang yul gyu gzhan nas dar khyab byung bar yul phyogs so serware khyad dzadas bsnan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gzhas kyi ngo bo gcig kyang sgra 168

la stod yul gzhas kyi gleng brjod/gdangs dang 'khrab bzo cung zad mi 'dra ba bcas gnyis yo da red/ dper na /yongs grags yul gzhas/ brag dkar rta so'i ri la ri bshad yod/ ces pa lta tsho bur mtshon na/ brag dkar ba dang nye 'khris rdzong dga' ba'i dbar yul gzhas 'di'i sgra gdangs 'khrab bzo cung zad mi mtshungs pa bzhin red/ de bzhin yul gzhas khag dar rabs la gzhigs te ga'as pa dza'ire ngag gi sgra gdangs dang rkang pa'i shodag gra mtshungs ched rol dbyangs sna tshogs dar sku da pas/ dper na 'brog sde spo rong ba'i gna' bo'i gzhas chen dang de min yul gzhas 'khrab tshul la mtshon na zhabs gzhas kyi kha 'o/ rnga chen zhig brdungs pa'i rnga'i sgra gdangs kyis bcun pa yin/ phyis su rim pas 'gyur 'gros kyis ding ri shel dkar lta bur mtshon na sgra snyan dang yi wang sogs kyi mo la cha bed spyod bya srol yod/ gna' dus lung tshan nang khul gzhas kyi 'gran bsdur yod 'dug pas de dus lus kyi 'khrab bzo dang skad kyi sgra gdangs legs par lha na dbo sa pa las gzhas tshig gsal por mi 'don par lkog sbas byed srol yod 'dug /der brten yul glu la lto ga glu brjod kyi yod 'dug /'on te deng gi gzhas pa mang che bas tha snyad 'di'i tshig don ma ༷ gas par gzhas tshig mngon gsal dod pos len zhing glu'i sgra gdangs la gzhas kyi lkog ces sgra gdangs dang lkog gnyis don gcig yin par brtsi srol 'di ni nor ba'o snyam/yul gzha sa 'khrab tshul ni/ do ru'am gzhas ru'i nang du gzhas dpon pho mo so so'i rjes su gzhas pa pho mo ji yod star bang sgor mo'i nang zhugs te /69
